ingredients_en: 1 head broccoli, cut into pieces (see "Cutting Tip") | 2 apples, cored and chopped into pieces | Cooked chicken (optional) in bite-size pieces | 1 cup chopped celery (optional) | ½ cup low-fat mayonnaise or low-fat plain yogurt | 1 small spoon sugar
steps_en: Bring a large pot of water, with a pinch of salt, to a boil. Add broccoli pieces and cook for 1-2 minutes. Drain and immediately put pieces in a bowl of cold water and ice cubes to stop the cooking. Let cool and drain. | Combine broccoli, apple, celery, and chicken (optional). | Mix mayonnaise or yogurt and sugar in a small bowl. | Add dressing to the broccoli and mix well. | Chill if desired.

ingredients_en: 1 head broccoli, broken into pieces (see "Cutting Tip") | 1 small spoon ginger, peeled and finely chopped | 2 large spoons orange juice | 1 large spoon soy sauce | 1 small spoon vegetable oil
steps_en: Steam or boil broccoli until tender and drain. | Combine grated ginger, orange juice, soy sauce, and oil in a small bowl and mix. | Pour sauce over broccoli and toss well.

title_es: Brócoli y Pan de Elote en Olla Eléctrica Tipo CrockPot
ingredients_en: ½ stick of butter or margarine, melted | 2 heads of broccoli separated into pieces (use stems, too; see "Cutting Tip") | 1 onion chopped | 1 box (8-9 ounces) of corn bread mix | 4 eggs, well beaten | 1 cup of cottage cheese | ½ small spoon of salt | 1 large spoon of vegetable oil
steps_en: Steam or boil the broccoli pieces until tender, drain. Chop into small pieces. | Heat oil in a frying pan and cook onions for 3-4 minutes, until they are soft. | Combine all ingredients and mix well. | Pour into a greased CrockPot. | Cook on low for 3 ½ -4 hours, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. | Turn pot over, remove bread, and cut into wedges.

ingredients_en: 1 head broccoli, chopped into pieces (see "Cutting Tip") | ¼ cup milk | 1 small spoon mustard | pinch of pepper | cooked chicken or meat (optional) | ½ can low-fat cream of mushroom soup | 2 green onions, chopped (optional) | 8 tortillas or taco shells | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | 1 cup shredded cheese
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease a baking dish. | Steam or boil broccoli pieces until tender. Drain and chop into small pieces. | Combine milk, mustard, and pepper in a large bowl. | Add broccoli, meat (optional), green onions (optional) and cream of mushroom soup and a ½ cup of cheese. | Spoon about a half cup of the mixture into the center of a tortilla. Fold in sides and roll up. | Place in a greased baking dish. | Bake for 15 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake 10 minutes more.

ingredients_en: 1 head of broccoli, cut into pieces (see "Cutting Tip") | water | salt and pepper, or lemon or lime juice (optional)
steps_en: Put about 1 cup of water into a pot, and bring to a boil. Add the broccoli. Cover with a lid and reduce heat to medium. | Cook for about 5 minutes, making sure that there is always some water in the pot. The broccoli should become bright green and remain firm. | Drain. Mix with pinch of salt and pepper, or lemon or lime juice, to taste.

ingredients_en: 1 head of broccoli, cut into pieces (see "Cutting Tip") | 2 large spoons vegetable oil | 2-3 cloves fresh garlic, chopped | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: Cook broccoli (either steam, boil, or microwave). Broccoli should turn bright green and stay firm. | Heat the oil in a pan on medium heat. Add the garlic, cook and stir until garlic starts to get soft. | Add broccoli, with a pinch of salt and pepper. Turn heat to high, cook and stir for another 2-3 minutes.

ingredients_en: 1 head of broccoli, florets and stems, peeled and sliced (see "Cutting Tip") | 2 large spoons of Italian dressing or 2 large spoons of vegetable oil | salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings, if using vegetable oil (optional) | 1 large spoon of vegetable oil
steps_en: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. | Mix broccoli pieces with Italian dressing or vegetable oil in a bowl. | Add a pinch of salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings and mix well, if using vegetable oil (optional). | Coat baking sheet with a large spoon of vegetable oil. Bake the broccoli for 9-12 minutes, or until tender. Turn broccoli once or twice during cooking.

ingredients_en: 1 head of broccoli, cut into pieces (see "Cutting tip") | 5-6 large spoons Italian dressing, more if needed to coat all vegetables | ½ package noodles, any shape (optional) | sliced pepper (optional) | sliced carrots (optional) | sliced mushrooms (optional) | sliced onion (optional) | can of olives, drained (optional) | fresh tomatoes, sliced (optional)
steps_en: Put broccoli pieces in a bowl with the other sliced vegetables. Mix with Italian dressing. | Refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or even overnight. Stir once or twice during this time. Vegetables will become tender, almost like cooking them. | Boil noodles according to the directions on the package. Drain noodles, mix with a large spoon of Italian dressing, and cool. | Combine vegetables with noodles and stir.

ingredients_en: 1 head of broccoli, cut into pieces (see "Cutting Tip") | 3 medium carrots | salt and pepper, or lemon or lime juice (optional) | water or broth
steps_en: Wash and peel carrots. Slice into rounds about as thick as a pencil. | Put about 2-3 cups of water or broth into a pot, and bring to a boil. Add carrot pieces. Cover with a lid and reduce heat to medium. Cook for about 5 minutes. | Add broccoli and cook for another 3 minutes. | Drain. Mix with pinch of salt and pepper, or lemon or lime juice, to taste.

title_es: Papas Rellenas con Brócoli al Horno
ingredients_en: 2 large baking potatoes | 1 cup cooked broccoli (steamed, boiled, or microwaved), chopped into small pieces | 2 large spoons of butter or margarine | 1 green onion, including green part, finely chopped (optional) | ½ cup low-fat sour cream (optional) | 1 cup shredded cheese, any kind (optional) | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: To bake the potatoes, first clean them and stab them several times with a fork or sharp knife. This will allow heat to be released as the potatoes bake. | Bake the potatoes for 50-60 minutes at 350 degrees. | Slice the potato in half, lengthwise. Scoop out the insides and mash in a bowl with the butter or margarine, until smooth. | Add the green onion, sour cream, or shredded cheese (optional). | Mix in pinch of salt and pepper. | Stir in the broccoli pieces. | Stuff the potato-broccoli filling into the potato skins. Put any extra filling in an oven proof container. | Cook the stuffed potatoes (and any extra filling) for 10-15 minutes at 350 degrees.

ingredients_en: 2 heads of broccoli, florets only (see "Cutting Tip") | 2 large spoons of vegetable oil | 2 large spoons butter or margarine | 4-6 cloves of garlic, chopped (optional) | 1 small spoon of chopped lemon peel (yellow part only) | 2 large spoons of lemon juice | a handful of nuts of any kind, cut into pieces (optional) | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. | Mix broccoli with 1 large spoon of oil and pinch of salt and pepper. | Coat a baking sheet with 1 large spoon of oil. Bake the broccoli for 8 minutes, or until tender, turning once or twice. | Melt butter or margarine in a pan over medium heat. Add garlic and lemon peel. Stir for about 1 minute. | Turn heat to low and add lemon juice. Cook another minute. | Mix broccoli with the lemon sauce until all the pieces are coated. Top with nuts (optional).

ingredients_en: 1 head of broccoli, cut into pieces (see "Cutting Tip") | 3-4 large spoons of water or broth | salt or pepper, to taste | lemon or lime juice (optional) | 2-3 large spoons of Italian dressing (optional)
steps_en: Place the broccoli pieces into a microwaveable dish. | Add water or broth and cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 4-5 minutes. | Add flavor with a pinch of salt or pepper, or lemon or lime juice to taste, or toss with some Italian dressing.

ingredients_en: 1 head of broccoli, cut into pieces (see "Cutting Tip") | water | salt or pepper | lemon or lime juice (optional) | 2-3 large spoons of Italian dressing (optional)
steps_en: Boil about 1 inch of water in a pot. | Place a steamer basket in the pot and place broccoli into the basket. | Cover, cook for 3-4 minutes. The broccoli should be a bright green and still firm. Test with a fork. | Add flavor with a pinch of salt or pepper, or lemon or lime juice to taste, or toss with some Italian dressing.

ingredients_en: 1-3 heads of broccoli, cut into pieces (see "Cutting Tip") | 4 boneless chicken breast halves, skinless | 2 large spoons butter, margarine, or vegetable oil | 1 can of low-fat cream soup (broccoli, mushroom, or chicken) | 2-3 ears of corn cut from the cob, or 1 can of corn, or a package of frozen corn (thawed) | ¾ cup milk, low fat | ½ cup shredded cheese, any kind (optional) | pepper, to taste
steps_en: Dry chicken breasts, sprinkle with pepper. | Heat a large pan on medium and add butter, margarine, or oil. Cook chicken 5-10 minutes or until browned, turning several times. Set chicken aside. | Combine remaining ingredients in pan. Heat until boiling. Return chicken and cover pan. | Cook, turning often, over low heat 10-20 minutes, until chicken is no longer pink inside and broccoli is tender-crisp.

ingredients_en: 2 heads of broccoli, cut into pieces (see "Cutting Tip") | 1 large can of tomatoes | 1 onion, chopped (optional) | 2 large spoons butter, margarine, or vegetable oil | 2-3 cloves of garlic, chopped (optional) | 2 cups of broth | pepper, to taste
steps_en: Put butter, margarine or oil and garlic and onion in a pot on medium heat. Stir until onion and garlic start to get soft. | Crush or chop the tomatoes. | Add broccoli, tomatoes (with juice), and broth to the pot. | Cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes, until broccoli pieces are tender. Stir a few times. Add a pinch of pepper. | Use a potato masher or a blender to crush vegetables (optional). | Add more broth to reduce thickness, if you want.

ingredients_en: 1-3 heads of broccoli, cut into pieces (see "Cutting tip") | ½-1 cup of cooked rice (follow instructions on package) | 1 egg beaten | 1 can of non-fat cream soup (broccoli, chicken or mushroom) | 1 cup of milk (lowfat) | 1 cup of shredded cheese (any kind)(optional) | 1 onion, chopped (optional) | 1 large spoon butter, margarine, or vegetable oil
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Combine all ingredients (except the butter, margarine, or oil) in a large bowl and mix well. | Coat inside of large baking dish with butter, margarine, or vegetable oil. Spoon mixture into dish. Bake 1 hour.

title_en: Broccoli, Black Bean, Corn, and Chicken/Meat Mix
title_es: Un Guiso de Brócoli, Fríjol Negro, Maíz y Pollo/Carne
ingredients_en: 1 can (15 oz.) black beans , drained | 1 can (14-15 oz.) creamed corn | 1 head of broccoli, cut into pieces (see "Cutting Tip"), about two cups | Any cooked meat or cooked chicken, 1-2 cups | Low-fat grated cheese, chopped avocado, or low-fat sour cream (optional)
steps_en: Combine beans and corn in a large pot. Heat gently, 3-4 minutes. | In a different pot, cook the broccoli pieces (steam, boil, or microwave). | Mix broccoli, beans, corn, and cooked meat. | Top with grated cheese, chopped avocado, or sour cream (optional).

ingredients_en: 4 large spoons of vegetable oil or butter | 8 large carrots, peeled and chopped into small pieces | 3 onions, peeled and chopped into small pieces | 3 cans of chicken broth or water | salt and pepper (optional) | 1 small container of non-fat plain yogurt (optional)
steps_en: Heat oil or butter in a large pot. | Add onions and cook until soft. | Add carrots and broth and bring to a boil. | Turn heat to low, cover pot and let simmer until carrots are tender when pierced, about 30 minutes. | Blend the carrot soup using a blender, hand mixer or potato masher. | Season with salt or pepper, to taste. | Serve warm or let soup cool and stir in yogurt for a cold soup. | Do not freeze if you add yogurt.

title_es: Zanahorias con Pollo - Toda una Comida en un Plato
ingredients_en: 4 carrots, peeled and cut into thumb-size pieces | 3 medium potatoes, sliced pencil-thick | 1 large onion, peeled and cut into wedges (optional) | 4 chicken breast halves | 2 large spoons of vegetable oil | 1 large spoon of margarine or butter | garlic or other seasonings (optional) | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Rub chicken parts with bits of margarine or butter, sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper. | Combine carrots, potatoes, and onion in baking dish and half of the oil, mix together. | Sprinkle the vegetables lightly with salt and pepper. You can also add garlic or other seasonings (optional). | Coat inside of baking dish with oil; place chicken on top of the vegetables. | Cover tightly with cover or foil and bake for 60 minutes; uncover and bake 10-15 minutes more.

ingredients_en: 6 carrots, shredded | 1 tomato, chopped (optional) | juice of one large lemon or lime | 3 pinches salt, or to taste | hot sauce, to taste | cilantro, one bunch or 3 large spoons, chopped (optional)
steps_en: Shred the carrots and chop the tomato. Mix together. | Add juice and salt. | Add hot sauce, to taste. | Add cilantro (optional). | Eat as a side dish or put in a sandwich or tortilla wrap.

ingredients_en: 2-3 large carrots, peeled and thinly sliced | 1-2 cups canned sliced jalapeño peppers (including juice) | other seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Boil carrots briefly, until cooked but not soft (about 7 minutes). | Drain carrots. Place them in a shallow plastic or glass dish with a tight-fitting lid. | Sprinkle your favorite seasonings over the carrots. | Pour in jalapeño peppers, including liquid. Let peppers sit on top of the carrots. | Cover and leave in refrigerator at least 12 hours before using. | Stir and eat both carrots and peppers.

title_es: Zanahorias Guisadas en una Olla Eléctrica Tipo "Crock Pot"
ingredients_en: 3 cups carrots, peeled and sliced, pencil thick | 2 large spoons of brown sugar | 2 large spoons butter or margarine, melted | salt or pepper | other seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Slice carrots and put into the CrockPot. | Sprinkle the carrots with brown sugar and a pinch of salt or pepper. | Add other seasonings, if you like. | Pour the melted butter or margarine over the carrots. | Toss all of the ingredients together. | Cover with lid and cook on high for 3 hours.

title_en: Maple Syrup and Brown Sugar Carrots
title_es: Zanahorias con Miel de Maple y Azúcar Morena
ingredients_en: 6-8 carrots, cut into chunks or slices | 1/3 cup water | 2 large spoons butter | 3 large spoons maple syrup | 1 large spoon brown sugar | 1 small spoon orange zest (optional) | salt and pepper (optional)
steps_en: Place all ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil. | Reduce heat to medium. Cover and simmer until carrots are crisp and tender, about 5-8 minutes. | Uncover and cook until juices are reduced, about 5 minutes. | Season with salt and pepper, to taste.

ingredients_en: 11-12 carrots, peeled and cut into sticks | ½ can tomato soup | ½ cup sugar | 2/3 cup vinegar | ¼ cup oil | ½ small spoon Worcestershire sauce | ½ small spoon mustard | salt and pepper, to taste | 1 onion, sliced in rings (optional) | 1 green pepper, cut into strips (optional)
steps_en: Bring water to boil. Add carrots and bring to a boil again. Cook until tender, but not soft, about 5 minutes. Drain and cool the carrots. | Mix tomato soup, sugar, vinegar, oil, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, salt and pepper. | Combine carrots and onions and green peppers. | Pour the tomato soup mixture over the vegetables. | Chill 8 hours. Stir once or twice.

ingredients_en: 4-6 carrots | water, to cover | salt and pepper (optional)
steps_en: Peel the carrots and cut into slices. | Bring water to a boil in a pot. | Add the carrots, cover the pot, and turn the heat down to medium-low. | Cook the carrots about 10 minutes, or until tender. Cook a shorter time if you prefer crisper carrots. | Season with salt or pepper to taste.

ingredients_en: 4-6 carrots, cut into slices | 1 large spoon of vegetable oil | 4 cloves chopped garlic (optional) | other chopped or sliced vegetables (optional) | pepper or other herbs or spices (optional) | 1 large spoon soy sauce (optional) | Any cooked meat in small pieces (optional)
steps_en: Heat the vegetable oil in a pan to very hot. | Add the chopped garlic, carrots, and other vegetables (optional). Stir for a minute. | Add pepper or other herbs or spices, and soy sauce. | Keep stirring and moving the vegetables until they are tender, 3-5 minutes. | Add meat and stir for a minute

ingredients_en: 6 carrots, shredded | handful of raisins | non-fat, plain yogurt | pinch of sugar (optional) | drained, crushed canned pineapple (optional)
steps_en: Mix the carrots and raisins together. | Add yogurt to moisten, as desired. Mix well. | Add sugar and drained pineapple, if you like. | Chill.

ingredients_en: 2 cups sliced carrots | 3 apples, thinly sliced | 2 large spoons flour | 4 large spoons brown sugar | ¾ cup orange juice
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Put 2 cups of water in a pot and bring to a boil. | Add the sliced carrots. Cover the pot and turn the heat down. | Cook for 5-7 minutes, or until tender. | Drain the carrots. | Combine the cooked carrots and apples in an 8"x8" baking dish. | Pour orange juice over the carrots and apples. | Mix the flour and brown sugar. Sprinkle the mixture over the carrots and apples; this will form a light crust. | Bake for 40 minutes.

ingredients_en: 4 cups carrots, sliced | 1 small onion, sliced | 2 small spoons vegetable oil | parsley (optional)
steps_en: Heat the oil in a frying pan. | Add the carrots and onions. | Cover and turn the heat down. | Check to make sure the carrots are not sticking. Stir if necessary. | Cook for 8-10 minutes, or until carrots and onions are tender. | Add the parsley (optional) and serve.

ingredients_en: 3 carrots, thinly sliced | 4 cloves garlic, chopped | 2 large spoons vegetable oil | juice of a lemon or an orange | handful of raisins (optional)
steps_en: Heat the oil in a frying pan. | Add the carrots and garlic and cook for 3 minutes. | Add juice and raisins to carrots and mix well. | Cover with lid and simmer 3 minutes or until the carrots are tender. | Remove from heat. Serve warm or cold.

ingredients_en: 1 small spoon vegetable oil | 4 cups carrots, peeled and sliced | 1 onion, chopped | 4 cloves garlic, chopped (optional) | 4 stalks celery, chopped (optional) | 1 can (28 oz.) whole tomatoes | salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings (optional) | 1 can (15 oz.) cannellini beans, or other beans (optional) | 4 cups water or chicken or vegetable stock
steps_en: Heat the oil in a pot. | Add the onion and the garlic and stir over medium heat until soft. | Add celery, carrots, tomatoes (including the liquid), and water or broth. Add seasonings. | Bring to boil. Then, reduce heat, cover pot and simmer 10-15 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender. | Add beans (including liquid) and bring to boil again.

ingredients_en: 4-6 carrots, sliced | 3-4 large spoons water or chicken or vegetable broth | salt or pepper (optional)
steps_en: Put carrots and 3-4 large spoons of water or broth into a microwavable dish. | Cook about 6 minutes on high. | Season with salt or pepper to taste.

title_es: Zanahorias Glaseadas con Mermelada de Naranja al Microondas
ingredients_en: 4-6 carrots, sliced | water or vegetable or chicken broth | 1 large spoon orange marmalade | 1 large spoon orange juice | raisins (optional)
steps_en: Put carrots and 3-4 large spoons of water or broth into a microwavable dish. | Cook about 6 minutes on high. | Add a handful of raisins to carrots (optional). | Combine marmalade and orange juice. Microwave this mixture on high for 30 seconds. | Pour over cooked carrots and mix well.

ingredients_en: 4-6 carrots, sliced | water | salt and pepper (optional)
steps_en: Place carrots into a steamer basket. | Pour just enough water in a pot so that water will not touch the bottom of the steamer basket. | Bring water to a boil. | Place steamer basket in pot and cover loosely. | Steam for 12 minutes, or until tender. | Season with salt or pepper to taste.

ingredients_en: 4-6 carrots, cut into chunks | 3 cloves garlic, sliced (optional) | 1-2 large spoons vegetable oil | pepper or other herbs or spices (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Toss carrots, sliced garlic, and a pinch of your favorite herbs or spices with a little vegetable oil. | Lightly coat the inside of a baking pan with oil. | Put carrots and garlic into the baking pan. | Bake for about 30-45 minutes, stirring a few times, or until tender.

title_es: Una Olla de Arroz con Pollo
ingredients_en: 2-3 large spoons vegetable oil | 4 chicken thighs or breasts | salt and pepper or favorite seasonings | 1 large onion, cut into medium pieces | 2 stalks celery, cut into 1 inch pieces (optional) | 4 carrots, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 cup rice | 2 cups approximately of water or chicken broth
steps_en: If needed, cut away fat and loose bits of meat from the chicken. Wash chicken and pat dry. Coat chicken pieces lightly with oil. Season with salt, pepper, or your favorite seasonings. | In a large pot, heat 1 large spoon of oil over medium-high heat. | Place chicken pieces in pot. Cook until golden brown on both sides, about 10-12 minutes. | Add onion and celery. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. | Add carrots and almost 2 cups of water or broth. Stir in rice. | Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and cook until rice absorbs all of the liquid, about 30-40 minutes. Let stand covered for about 10 minutes before serving.

ingredients_en: 1 head of cabbage, shredded | 2 large spoons of margarine or butter | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | 3 large spoons packed brown sugar | 3 or 4 cloves of garlic, chopped | 1 small onion, sliced thinly (optional) | 2 large spoons vinegar | pinch of salt and pepper
steps_en: In a large pan, heat margarine or butter, and oil over medium heat. | Add garlic, onion, brown sugar, and salt and pepper. | Add cabbage and cook until the cabbage starts to soften, about 3-5 minutes. | Reduce heat to medium-low and stir in vinegar. | Cook, stirring often, for approximately 5 minutes, or more if cabbage is still too crunchy.

ingredients_en: 1 pound lean ground beef | 1 pinch salt | 1 pinch pepper | 1 medium onion, chopped (optional) | ½ cup quick cooking rice | ½ head of cabbage, chopped | 1 can tomato soup | 1 soup can of water | 1 large spoon vegetable oil
steps_en: Heat oil in pan, and cook beef and onion together. Drain off excess oil. Add salt and pepper. | Stir rice into beef mixture. | Place chopped cabbage in a large casserole dish. | Spread beef, onion and rice mixture over the cabbage. | Pour and spread tomato soup over top of beef mixture. | Fill soup can with water and pour evenly over casserole. | Cover and bake one hour at 350 degrees. | To make in a toaster oven, cut the recipe in half.

ingredients_en: ½ head cabbage, shredded (do not use the white center) | 8 small tomatoes, diced | 1 small onion, diced | 1 jalapeño pepper, diced (optional) | 3 large spoons lime juice | 1 small spoon salt | 1 small spoon sugar | 3 large spoons chopped cilantro or celery (optional) | 1 clove garlic, chopped (optional)
steps_en: Combine all ingredients. | Chill for 2 hours. | Serve with tortilla chips, pita bread, tortillas, or cut fresh vegetables.

ingredients_en: ½ head cabbage, chopped into medium pieces | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | 1 large spoon margarine or butter | salt and pepper | 1 cup chicken or vegetable broth (or water)
steps_en: Heat oil and margarine or butter in large saucepan. | Add cabbage, salt, and pepper and stir on low heat for 5 minutes. | Add broth and bring to a boil. | Cover and simmer over medium-low heat, stirring often for about 15 minutes, until cabbage is tender. | Increase to medium heat. Uncover and let juices reduce to about half.

ingredients_en: 3 large spoons vegetable oil | ½ cup onion, chopped | ½ cup celery, chopped (optional) | 1 cup carrots, chopped (optional) | 5 cups cabbage, shredded | 1 small spoon sugar | salt and pepper, to taste | 1 can (16 ounces) whole tomatoes with liquid
steps_en: In large pan, heat vegetable oil. | Cook onions, celery and carrots until tender. | Add cabbage, sugar, salt, pepper, and tomatoes. | Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low. | Cover and cook 5-8 minutes.

title_es: Guiso de Repollo/Col y Verduras al Horno
ingredients_en: 1 medium cabbage, chopped | 4 large onions, sliced | 2 cups mushrooms, chopped (optional) | 1 cup bell peppers, chopped (optional) | 3 cups carrots, thinly sliced (optional) | 3 cups celery, thinly sliced (optional) | 1 can chicken broth or water | 1 cup shredded low-fat cheese | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. | In large bowl, mix together the cabbage, mushrooms, peppers, carrots, and celery--or whatever combination of vegetables you choose--and salt and pepper. | Coat inside of large casserole dish with oil or non-fat spray. | Add vegetables to casserole dish. | Pour chicken broth or water over the vegetables. | Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes. | Remove from oven, uncover, and add the cheese. | Bake, uncovered, for another 5-10 minutes, until cheese melts. | To make in a toaster oven, cut the recipe in half.

ingredients_en: ½ large onion, peeled and chopped | 1 large spoon margarine, butter, or vegetable oil | 2 cups water | 3-4 cups cabbage, chopped | 2 cups potatoes, cut into small pieces | 4 carrots, peeled and sliced (optional) | 2 ½ cups chicken or vegetable broth | pinch of salt, pepper, or favorite seasoning (optional) | 1 small spoon garlic, chopped (optional)
steps_en: In large pot, cook onion in margarine, butter, or oil until tender. | Add all other ingredients. | Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes.

title_es: Guiso de Repollo/Col, Manzana y Pollo
ingredients_en: 1 head cabbage, chopped | 2-3 cups apples, peeled and sliced (usually 2 apples) | 1 medium onion, sliced (optional) | 4 garlic cloves, finely chopped (optional) | 2 large spoons sugar | pinch of salt and pepper | pieces of one half chicken, with skin removed | ¼ cup chicken broth | 3-4 small spoons margarine or butter | 2 large spoons vegetable oil
steps_en: Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees. | Rub chicken pieces with salt and pepper. | Heat oil in hot pan; add chicken and half the garlic and cook until chicken is no longer pink, about 15 minutes; remove chicken from pan. | Add onion slices to pan and cook until they are starting to get soft, a few minutes more. | Combine cabbage, apples, onion, and remaining garlic in a mixture. | Spread a layer of half the mixture in casserole dish; add chicken on top. | Sprinkle some sugar, salt and pepper over chicken. | Spread another layer of the cabbage mixture over this. | Sprinkle rest of sugar, salt and pepper. | Add chicken broth evenly. | Dot with margarine or butter. | Cover casserole dish with aluminum foil; bake for 30 minutes. | Uncover, and bake another 15 minutes.

ingredients_en: 1 head cabbage, cut into long strips | 1 bell pepper, cut into strips | 1 tomato, thinly sliced | 1 onion, thinly sliced | ½ of a cucumber, thinly sliced (optional) | juice of 1 lemon or 1 large spoon lemon juice | 1 small spoon sugar | 2 pinches of salt
steps_en: Mix all the vegetables in a bowl. | Combine lemon juice, sugar, and salt. | Toss vegetables, while adding the lemon juice mixture. | Cover bowl tightly with plastic and refrigerate for 2-4 hours before serving.

ingredients_en: 1 head cabbage, cut into wedges | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | pinch of salt and pepper | 1 small spoon vinegar or lemon juice (optional)
steps_en: Boil water in a large pot. | Drop wedges of cabbage into the boiling water. | Cook uncovered for 10-15 minutes. | Drain thoroughly. Press towel over cabbage to remove excess moisture. | Combine with oil, salt, or pepper, and very small amount of vinegar or lemon juice to bring out flavors.

ingredients_en: 1 head cabbage | 2 large spoons water, chicken stock or apple juice
steps_en: Cut the cabbage into 8 to 10 wedges, removing white core. | Place in a microwave safe dish with 2 large spoonfuls of liquid (water or stock or apple juice). | Cover and microwave at normal power for 5-7 minutes.

ingredients_en: 2 large spoons vegetable oil | 2 cups vegetables (carrots, broccoli, onions, or others) | ½ head cabbage, shredded | 1 large spoon garlic, chopped (optional) | 1-2 large spoons soy sauce | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into 1 inch pieces (optional)
steps_en: Heat vegetable oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat. | Add vegetables (except cabbage and garlic). Cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring quickly and constantly. | Add chicken pieces, stir for 2-3 minutes (optional). | Add cabbage and stir until the cabbage is tender. | Add garlic and soy sauce to taste. | Cook for one more minute.

ingredients_en: 1-2 large spoons margarine, butter, or vegetable oil | ½ head cabbage, shredded | 1 large onion, thinly sliced | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: Heat margarine, butter, or oil in a frying pan. | Add onions and cook about 2 minutes. | Add cabbage, salt, and pepper to pan and cook until cabbage is tender, about 5 minutes; stir often during cooking.

ingredients_en: ½ head cabbage | water
steps_en: Cut cabbage into wedges or slices, and place in steamer basket. | Pour just enough water in a pot, so that water will not touch bottom of steamer basket. Bring water to a boil. Place basket in pot and cover. | Cook large wedges for 15 minutes; smaller wedges or slices will take about 10 minutes.

ingredients_en: 1 head cabbage, shredded | 12 ounces noodles | 1 cup grated cheese (Swiss cheese or other cheese) | 1 large spoon butter, margarine, or vegetable oil | salt or pepper, to taste | pinch of red pepper flakes or other seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Heat pot of lightly salted water to boiling. Add noodles and cook according to package directions. Drain noodles. | Heat butter, margarine, or vegetable oil in a frying pan. Add cabbage, salt, and pepper, and cook 10-15 minutes. | Combine cooked noodles and cabbage in a bowl. Toss with grated cheese and pinch of pepper flakes or other seasonings.

ingredients_en: ½ head cabbage, shredded | 1 carrot, diced (optional) | 1 apple, diced (optional) | ¼ red onion, diced (optional) | 1 cup low-fat plain yogurt or low-fat mayonnaise | 1 large spoon vinegar or to taste | 2 small spoons sugar
steps_en: Combine all ingredients. | Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

ingredients_en: 1 head cabbage, shredded | 1 apple, sliced | 1 large spoon margarine, butter, or vegetable oil | 1 onion, chopped | pinch of salt and pepper | 1 large spoon brown sugar | 1 cup water | 1 tablespoon vinegar
steps_en: Heat the margarine, butter, or oil in a pan. | Add onion and cook for one minute. | Add cabbage and cook for 3 to 5 minutes. | Add apples, salt, pepper, and brown sugar. | Cook for 5 minutes, stirring. | Add the water and vinegar and cook, covered, over low heat for about 30 minutes. Stir occasionally.

title_es: Repollo/Col, Cebollas y Papas al Sartén
ingredients_en: 1 head cabbage, shredded | 2 large potatoes, peeled and diced | 1 large onion, sliced thinly | ¼ cup vegetable oil | 2 large spoons water or broth | red pepper flakes (optional) | salt or pepper or other seasonings (optional)
steps_en: In a large pan, heat the oil. | Add potatoes and cook over medium heat until lightly browned. | Add the cabbage, onions, and water or broth. | Season with red pepper flakes or salt or pepper or other seasonings. | Cover and cook over low heat until the potatoes are tender about 10 to 15 minutes; stir often. | To prevent the vegetables from browning, reduce the heat or add more water or broth.

title_es: Repollo/Col y Chili en Olla Eléctrica Tipo Crock-Top
ingredients_en: 3-4 cups chopped cabbage | 2 chopped onions | 2 12-ounce cans chopped tomatoes | 1 pound of ground beef or ground turkey (optional) | 2 16-ounce cans kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 large spoon of chili seasoning or other seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Combine all ingredients in CrockPot and mix well. | Cover and cook over low heat for 6-8 hours. | Mix well before serving.

title_es: Repollo/Col, Fideos y Salsa de Cacahuate
ingredients_en: 2/3 cup chunky peanut butter | 4 cups fresh spinach or other greens (losely packed) | 8 or more large spooons of vegetable oil | salt, to taste | 1 head of cabbage | 1 package noodles (12 oz.) any shape, cooked according to package directions | cooked meat, such as chicken or pork (optional)
steps_en: Cut the cabbage in half and remove the woody stem at the bottom (see photo). Cut the cabbage into thin strips. | Place the peanut butter and greens in a blender or food processor. Turn on low speed. | Slowly pour in oil, in a thin stream. Use enough oil to make a smooth sauce. In between blending, you may need to use the handle of a spoon to push the ingredients together so that they blend smoothly. | Turn off the food processor and taste. Add salt if needed. | Place cabbage and cooked noodles in a large mixing bowl. Add sauce and mix well. | Stir in cooked meat, if you wish.

ingredients_en: 1 pound ground beef or ground turkey | 2 cups of cabbage, finely chopped | half an onion, finely chopped (optional) | ¾ cup ketchup | 1-2 large spoons brown sugar | half a small spoon garlic powder (optional) | 1 small spoon mustard | salt and pepper, to taste (optional) | 4-6 hamburger buns
steps_en: In a bowl, mix beef, cabbage and onion. | Put this mixture in a pan and cook over medium heat until meat is browned. Drain any excess liquid. | Mix together the ketchup, brown sugar, garlic powder, and mustard. | Stir in ketchup mixture. Cook over medium heat for 30 minutes or until cabbage is as tender as you want. Stir occasionally. taste and season with salt and pepper, if desired. | Serve on hamburger buns.

ingredients_en: 1 head of cauliflower, broken into pieces | water
steps_en: Place the cauliflower into a steamer basket. | Pour just enough water in a pot so that water will not touch the bottom of the steamer basket. | Bring water to a boil. Place steamer basket in pot and cover. | Steam for 3-7 minutes or until just tender.

ingredients_en: 1 head of cauliflower, broken into pieces | water | 1 large spoon butter or margarine (optional) | salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Fill a pot halfway with water and bring to a boil. | Add the cauliflower to boiling water and cook until tender, about 5 to 8 minutes. | Drain the cauliflower. | Heat butter or margarine in a pan with a pinch of salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings. | Pour this mixture over the cauliflower and stir gently to coat the pieces.

title_es: Coliflor Preparada en un Horno de Microondas
ingredients_en: 1 head of cauliflower, broken into pieces | water | 1 large spoon butter or margarine (optional) | salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Place the cauliflower in a microwaveable dish. | Add ¼ cup water and cover with lid or plastic wrap. | Microwave on high for 3 minutes and then let stand for 2 more minutes. | Heat butter or margarine in a pan with a pinch of salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings. | Pour this mixture over the cauliflower and stir gently to coat the pieces.

ingredients_en: 1 head of cauliflower, sliced | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | 2 large spoons chopped garlic, chopped onions, or both | salt and pepper, to taste (optional)
steps_en: Heat oil in a pan. | Add garlic or onions and cook for a few seconds on medium heat. | Add the cauliflower and cook for 3-4 minutes. | Add salt and pepper to taste.

title_es: Ensalada de Coliflor, Zanahoria y Apio
ingredients_en: 1 head of cauliflower, broken into small pieces | 3 medium carrots, shredded | 3 stalks of celery, chopped | Dressing: | 4 large spoons vegetable oil | 4 large spoons vinegar | 4 large spoons water | 1 small spoon sugar | 1 small spoon seasoning salt or salt | ½ cup lightly packed fresh celery leaves, chopped (optional)
steps_en: In a large bowl, mix cauliflower, carrots and celery. | To make salad dressing, mix all salad dressing ingredients. | Pour dressing over vegetables and mix well. | Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

ingredients_en: 1 head cauliflower, broken into pieces | 1 small onion, chopped | ½ cup grated low-fat cheddar cheese | 1 can low-fat cream of mushroom soup or cream of chicken or cream of celery soup | ½ cup low-fat milk | 1 box frozen peas, thawed (optional) | cooked chicken (optional)
steps_en: Steam or boil cauliflower and onions until tender, about 3 to 5 minutes. Drain. | Place the cauliflower and onions in a baking dish. | Add peas and cooked chicken (optional). | Mix soup with milk in a separate bowl. | Pour soup mixture over cauliflower and stir. Sprinkle with cheese. | Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes.

ingredients_en: 1 head cauliflower, broken into small pieces | 4 garlic cloves, peeled and then crushed (optional) | 5 large spoons non-fat plain yogurt | 2 small spoons margarine or butter | salt and pepper, to taste | pinch of any favorite seasoning (optional)
steps_en: Boil or steam cauliflower and garlic until tender. | Drain off liquid and mash cauliflower and garlic with a potato masher or a blender. | Add yogurt, margarine or butter, and salt and pepper. | Mix thoroughly. | Add any other favorite seasoning.

ingredients_en: 1 head cauliflower, broken into pieces | 3 apples, cored and chopped into pieces | 1 head broccoli, cut into pieces (optional) | 1 cup chopped celery | ½ cup low-fat mayonnaise or non-fat plain yogurt | 1 small spoon sugar
steps_en: Bring a large pot of water, with a pinch of salt, to a boil. Add cauliflower pieces and cook, covered, for 1-2 minutes. Then, add broccoli pieces and cook, covered, for another 1-2 minutes. Drain and immediately put pieces in a bowl of cold water and ice cubes to stop the cooking. Drain when vegetables are cool to the touch. | Combine cauliflower, broccoli (optional), apple, and celery. | Mix mayonnaise, or yogurt and sugar in a small bowl to make a dressing. | Add dressing to the vegetable and fruit and mix well. | For a really crisp salad, use raw cauliflower and broccoli pieces. Or, you may place pieces in a pot of boiling, lightly salted water. Cook them for 5 minutes, drain, and put pieces in ice cubes and water to chill. | Chill finished salad, if desired, approximately 30 minutes.

ingredients_en: 1 head cauliflower, broken into pieces | 1 head broccoli, broken into pieces | 1 large spoon water | 2 pinches chili powder | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | 1 small spoon finely chopped ginger (optional) | 4 garlic cloves, finely chopped (optional) | salt and pepper to taste | 1 carrot, thinly sliced (optional) | 1 green onion, thinly sliced (optional) | 2 large spoons soy sauce (optional) | any cooked meat, cut in small pieces (optional)
steps_en: Boil or steam cauliflower and broccoli until tender, drain. | In a small dish, combine water and chili powder. | Heat the oil in a fry pan. Add chicken. Cook until golden brown. Add ginger and garlic (optional). | Cook for 30 seconds; do not let the garlic get brown. | Add the carrot (optional) and cook for 1 minute. | Add the cauliflower and broccoli, toss and stir for about 2 minutes. | Add water and chili powder to pan, stir until mixed. | Add soy sauce and meat pieces (optional). | Add green onion (optional). | Add salt and pepper to taste.

ingredients_en: 1 small onion, chopped into very small pieces | 1 lime | 1 head cauliflower, broken into pieces | 1 (14 ounce) can chopped tomatoes, drained | 1-4 fresh jalapeño peppers, seeded and chopped | pinch of sugar | 1 small spoon salt | ½ cup shredded cheese (optional)
steps_en: Steam or boil the cauliflower until tender, then drain. | Put the tomatoes, peppers, onion, and sugar in a fry pan. | Peel thin strips of lime and add to the tomato mixture. | Cut the lime in half and squeeze the juice from both halves into the tomato mixture. | Heat gently, until onion softens. | Add cauliflower. | Mix well together. | Add cheese (optional).

title_es: Guiso de Coliflor en Olla Eléctrica Tipo "Crock-Pot"
ingredients_en: 3 cups cooked rice | 1 head cauliflower, broken into pieces | 1 can low-fat cream of mushroom soup | 2 cups grated low-fat cheese | ½ cup water | 1 medium onion, diced (optional) | 1 cup peas, fresh or frozen-thawed (optional) | 1 cup corn, frozen-thawed, or canned drained (optional) | 1 cup diced carrots (optional) | 6-10 mushrooms, sliced (optional) | 1 large spoon vegetable oil
steps_en: Spray CrockPot with nonstick cooking spray, or coat with vegetable oil. | Combine all ingredients in CrockPot. Stir well. | Cook on low for 4 hours.

title_es: Coliflor con Aderezo de Mostaza y Limon
ingredients_en: 1 head cauliflower, sliced | 3 large spoons margarine or butter | 1 large spoon lemon juice | 1 small spoon mustard | 1-2 small spoons grated lemon peel (optional) | vegetable oil
steps_en: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. | Oil a baking sheet. | Put cauliflower slices on baking sheet. | Bake until cauliflower is slightly softened, about 10 minutes. | Melt margarine or butter in small pan over medium heat. | Add lemon juice, mustard and lemon peel (optional). | Spoon mustard-lemon sauce over cauliflower slices. | Bake 10 minutes longer then serve.

title_es: Coliflor, Brócoli y Salsa de Jitomate
ingredients_en: 1 small spoon oil | 1 small onion, chopped | 1 clove garlic, chopped (optional) | 1 head cauliflower, broken into pieces | 1 head broccoli, broken into pieces | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | salt and pepper, to taste | noodles, cooked (optional)
steps_en: Heat a pan. Add oil and cook onions and garlic until tender. | Steam or boil the cauliflower and broccoli, for 5-7 minutes. | Put the cauliflower, broccoli, and onions in a dish. | Heat spaghetti sauce in a pan and pour over cauliflower mixture and mix well. | Add cooked noodles (optional), and mix. | Season with salt and pepper to taste.

ingredients_en: 1 large spoon vegetable oil | 2 chicken breasts, boneless and skinless, cut into small pieces | salt or pepper, to taste | 1 head cauliflower, broken into pieces | 1 bell pepper, cut into pieces (optional) | 1 onion, chopped (optional) | ½ cup low-fat sour cream or plain yogurt | 1 cup shredded low-fat cheddar cheese | ½ cup crushed cornflakes
steps_en: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. | Put oil in a pan and heat. | Sprinkle salt or pepper on chicken pieces. Place chicken in pan and stir until brown on all sides, about 5 minutes. | Put cauliflower in pan, add 1 cup water; cover and cook on medium for 5 minutes. | Drain off the liquid. | Add bell pepper and onion to pan and cook for 1 minute. | Add sour cream and half of cheese to the chicken-cauliflower mixture. | Put in greased baking dish. | Bake, uncovered, at 400 degrees for 15 minutes. | Take out of oven, top with remaining cheese and crushed cornflakes. | Bake for another 5 minutes.

ingredients_en: 1 head cauliflower, sliced or broken into pieces | 1-2 bags or bunches of spinach | 1 small onion, chopped (optional) | 2 large spoons vegetable oil | 1 large spoon of butter | 2 cloves chopped garlic (optional) | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: Add oil and butter to pan and heat on medium. | Add cauliflower, garlic and onion to pan, cover pan with a lid and cook until cauliflower begins to brown. | Place the fresh spinach on top of the cauliflower. It will quickly cook down. Stir all ingredients. | Season, to taste.

ingredients_en: 1 head cauliflower, broken into pieces | ½ stick margarine or butter | 2-3 large spoons of brown sugar
steps_en: Heat pan and melt half of margarine or butter. | Add the cauliflower and cook, turning often, until tender and brown, about 5-7 minutes. | Combine brown sugar with other half of margarine or butter. Add this mixture to the cauliflower. | Continue stirring and cook 3-4 minutes until cauliflower is coated with the melted brown sugar.

ingredients_en: 1 head cauliflower, broken into pieces | 4 large spoons low-fat sour cream | 1 small spoon chopped onions or green onions | 1 small spoon mustard | ¾ cup shredded low-fat cheddar cheese
steps_en: Steam or boil cauliflower until tender. | In a bowl, mix sour cream, onion, and mustard. | Add sour cream mixture to cauliflower. | Add cheese, cover and let stand for 3 minutes.

ingredients_en: 1 head cauliflower, broken into pieces | 3 large spoons vegetable oil | salt and pepper or other favorite seasonings
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | In a bowl, toss cauliflower with oil and seasonings. | Spread on an oiled baking sheet, or a baking sheet covered with aluminum foil. | Bake in oven for 15 minutes, until brown and tender.

ingredients_en: 1 head cauliflower, broken into pieces | 2 small spoons vegetable oil | 1 medium bell pepper, seeded and cut into strips | 3 cloves garlic, chopped (optional) | pinch of crushed red pepper | ½ cup vegetable broth, chicken broth, or water
steps_en: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. | Cook cauliflower for 1 minute, stirring. | Add bell pepper, garlic, and crushed red pepper and cook for another 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently. | Add broth or water, cover and cook 12 to 15 minutes until tender and brown.

ingredients_en: 1 head cauliflower, broken into pieces | 1 grated potato (leave skin on) | 1 egg | ½ cup breadcrumbs or flour | 3 stalks green onions or 1 small onion, chopped | 1 small spoon salt or seasoned salt | 4 large spoons vegetable oil | pinch of salt and pepper (optional) | sour cream, applesauce, or salsa (optional)
steps_en: Steam or boil cauliflower in water until soft. | Drain and mash the cauliflower. | Add egg, grated potato, onion, salt, pepper (optional), and breadcrumbs or flour and mix well. | Shape into patties. | Heat 2 large spoons of oil in frying pan and put several patties in pan, cook 4 to 5 minutes on each side, or until brown. | Add 2 more large spoons of oil and cook remaining patties. | Top the patties with a spoon of sour cream, applesauce, or salsa (optional).

ingredients_en: 1 head cauliflower, broken into pieces | 2 small onions, chopped | 2 carrots, sliced thinly | 1 can vegetable broth, chicken broth, or water | 1 cup shredded low-fat cheddar cheese | 1 small spoon vegetable oil | salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings, to taste
steps_en: Heat oil in a pot. | Add onions and cook until soft. | Add cauliflower and seasonings, and cook until cauliflower turns golden brown. | Add broth and bring to boil. | Add carrots and cook until soft, about 6 to 8 minutes. | Mix using a blender, hand mixer, or a potato masher. | Add cheese and mix again.

ingredients_en: 2 cups trimmed green beans | ½ lemon | 1-2 large spoons vegetable oil | salt or pepper (optional)
steps_en: Bring pot of water to a boil and cook beans until crisp-tender, 4-5 minutes. Drain and pat dry with a towel. | Cut the thin outer peel from a lemon, and slice these pieces into narrow strips. | Squeeze the juice from half a lemon and combine with vegetable oil. Add the beans and toss to coat them. | Add lemon peel strips and sprinkle with salt or pepper, if desired. Mix together.

ingredients_en: 4 cups trimmed green beans cut into small pieces | 1 onion, chopped | 1 large spoon butter or margarine | 2 tomatoes, cut into small chunks (optional) | ¾ cup salsa | 4 garlic clove, chopped (optional) | salt and pepper to taste
steps_en: Bring pot of water to a boil. Add green beans and simmer until tender. Drain. | In another pan, heat butter or margarine. Fry onions and garlic until brown. | Add green beans, tomatoes, and salsa to onion mixture. | Add salt or pepper to taste.

ingredients_en: 3 cups potatoes, peeled and cut into medium cubes | ½ onion, thinly sliced (optional) | 3 cups of green beans, cut into 2 inch pieces | ½ cup finely chopped celery (optional) | Dressing: | ¼ cup low-fat mayonnaise, mixed with 1 small spoon mustard | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: In a pot, put the potatoes, pinch of salt, and enough water to cover the potatoes. | Bring to a boil. Lower the heat and cook until the potatoes are tender, 7-10 minutes. | Remove potatoes with slotted spoon, dry them on a towel. | Add the green beans to the pot of hot water (where the potatoes were cooked) and cook until tender, 4-5 minutes. Drain and dry. | In a bowl, combine the dressing and all the other ingredients. | Mix gently to spread dressing. | Refrigerate until ready to serve.

title_en: Crock Pot Green Bean and Potato Casserole
title_es: Guiso de Ejotes y Papas en una Olla Eléctrica Tipo "Crock Pot"
ingredients_en: 6 cups green beans, cut in half | 2-3 potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 onion, chopped | 3-4 strips of bacon, cut into small pieces (optional) | pinch of pepper | 1 can low-fat cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
steps_en: Spray the pot with cooking spray or lightly grease with butter or oil. | Heat a frying pan and add the bacon. Cook 4-5 minutes until starting to brown. | Pour fat from the pan and add the onions. Cook for 3-4 minutes, until soft. | Combine potatoes, green beans, onion, bacon (optional), soup, and pinch of pepper in the pot. | Cover and cook on High for 3 hours.

ingredients_en: 1 medium onion, chopped | 4 cups of green beans, cut into small pieces | ½ small spoon of salt | 2 cloves of garlic chopped finely (optional) | 2 large spoons flour | 1 cup non-fat sour cream | salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings to taste
steps_en: Heat oil in pot. Add onions and cook until brown, stirring occasionally. | Add beans, salt, and garlic to pot and stir together with onions for 2 minutes. | Add water to 1 inch over the top of the mixture. | Bring to a boil, and then reduce to a simmer. Cook for 12-14 minutes or until beans are soft. | Combine flour and sour cream in a bowl. Stir in several large spoons of hot liquid from the soup pot to warm the sour cream mixture. | Add the sour cream mixture to the soup, stirring thoroughly. | Bring mixture to a simmer and stir over heat for another 2 minutes. | Add salt, pepper, and favorite seasonings to taste.

ingredients_en: green beans (1 handful per person) | water | pinch of salt | lemon juice or other seasonings (optional) | toasted nuts (optional)
steps_en: Wash the beans and cut off the ends. | Boil lightly salted water in a pot. | Drop the green beans into the pot of boiling water. | Cook uncovered for 4 to 5 minutes until just tender. Remove from the heat and drain. | Sprinkle with lemon juice or other seasonings. | To toast nuts, heat oven or counter top oven to 350 degrees. Put nuts on a metal tray, stir frequently with a fork. Watch to make sure that the nuts do not burn. | Sprinkle toasted nuts on the cooked green beans. | Another option is to cool the cooked beans by rinsing them with cold water. Then you can add the green beans to a salad.

ingredients_en: green beans (1 handful per person) | water | lemon juice or other seasonings (optional) | toasted nuts (optional)
steps_en: Wash the beans and cut off the ends. | Put the beans into a steamer basket over boiling water. | Cover the pan loosely and steam about 5 minutes, until just tender. | Sprinkle with lemon juice or other seasonings. | To toast nuts, heat oven or countertop oven to 350 degrees. Put nuts on a metal tray, stir frequently with a fork. Watch to make sure that the nuts do not burn. | Sprinkle toasted nuts on the cooked green beans. | Another option is to cool the cooked beans by rinsing them with cold water. Then you can add the green beans to a salad.

ingredients_en: green beans (1 handful per person) | water | lemon juice or other seasonings (optional) | toasted nuts (optional)
steps_en: Wash the beans and cut off the ends. | Place green beans in a microwavable dish with ¼ cup of water. | Cover with plastic or waxed paper. | Cook on high for about 4-5 minutes, until just tender. | Sprinkle with lemon juice or other seasonings. | To toast nuts, heat oven or countertop oven to 350 degrees. Put nuts on a metal tray, stir frequently with a fork. Watch to make sure that the nuts do not burn. | Sprinkle toasted nuts on the cooked green beans. | Another option is to cool the cooked beans by rinsing them with cold water. Then you can add the green beans to a salad.

ingredients_en: green beans (1 handful per person) | water | garlic (half a peeled clove per person); sliced thinly (optional) | 1 large spoon of vegetable oil | salt, pepper, other seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Wash the beans and cut off the ends. | Boil water in a pot. | Drop the green beans into the pot of boiling water. | Cook for 3 to 4 minutes; beans should remain crisp. | Remove quickly from the heat and drain the water. Put beans in a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking; drain again. | When ready to serve, put oil in a pan, heat to moderately high, and add the garlic and stir for a minute or two. | Then, add the cooked beans; stir for 2-3 minutes. | Season with salt or pepper or other seasonings during cooking.

ingredients_en: green beans (1 handful per person) | 1 clove garlic per handful, peeled and sliced thickly (optional) | 1 large spoon of vegetable oil | salt, pepper, other seasonings
steps_en: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. | Wash the beans and cut off the ends. | Lightly coat a baking sheet with vegetable oil or non-stick cooking spray. | Toss the beans, garlic slices, and seasonings (to taste) in vegetable oil. | Spread on sheet in one layer. Cook for 10-15 minutes, turning several times. | Discard any overcooked slices of garlic.

title_en: Stir-Fried Green Beans with Vegetables and Meat
title_es: Ejotes Fritos con Verduras y Carne
ingredients_en: green beans (one handful; all ingredients and proportions are up to you) | 3-4 large spoons of vegetable oil | chicken parts (or other meat) without skin or bones, cut into pieces the size of a finger | pinch of pepper, salt, or other seasonings | soy sauce | Optional Vegetables: | broccoli pieces | bell pepper, top cut off, insides and seeds removed, sliced into strips | onion, peeled and sliced thinly | garlic cloves, peeled and sliced thinly | any other vegetables
steps_en: Wash the beans and cut off the ends; cut the beans in half. | Prepare other vegetables, if used. | Sprinkle meat with pepper. | Heat large frying pan to very hot temperature, and add 1 large spoon of oil. | Place meat in pan. Stir constantly and remove quickly when browned; keep warm. | Add 2 large spoons of oil to pan. | Cook and stir onion and garlic (optional) until they begin to soften. Add green beans and your choice of other vegetables. | Sprinkle a little soy sauce onto mixture; scatter pinch of salt, pepper, and other seasonings (optional); cook mixture, stirring constantly, until tender, 5-7 minutes. | Return meat pieces and juices to pan. Stir and cook one minute.

title_en: Cold Green Bean and Tomato Salad
title_es: Ensalada de Ejotes Fríos y Jitomate
ingredients_en: green beans (1 handful) | 2 or 3 tomatoes, sliced into wedges | ½ onion, thinly sliced (optional) | 1-2 large spoons low-fat Italian dressing | pinch of pepper (optional)
steps_en: Wash the beans and cut off the ends. Drop beans in boiling water and cook until just tender, 3-4 minutes. Drain and place in ice water to stop cooking; drain again. | Put vegetables into a bowl. Add Italian dressing and pinch of pepper. Mix thoroughly. | Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

ingredients_en: green beans (1 handful) | 2 carrots, cut into rounds | 1 onion, cut into wedges (optional) | 1-2 large spoons margarine or butter | pinch of salt, pepper, or other seasonings, such as garlic powder (optional)
steps_en: Wash the beans and cut off the ends. | Bring pot of water to boil (enough to cover vegetables);drop carrots into water and simmer (just below boiling) for 8-10 minutes, covered. | Then, add green beans and cook for 3-4 minutes. | Drain; mix thoroughly with margarine or butter and seasonings.

ingredients_en: green beans (1 handful) | 1 bell pepper, seeds removed, cut into strips | 1 onion, cut into wedges | 2 large spoons margarine or butter | pinch of salt and pepper | shredded, low-fat cheese (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Wash the beans and cut off the ends. | Coat a baking dish with a little vegetable oil. | Toss vegetables with margarine or butter and a pinch of salt and pepper. | Bake vegetables for 30-35 minutes. | If you want, top with cheese for the last 5 minutes of baking. Do not freeze if you use cheese.

title_en: Green Beans with Tomatoes and Onions
ingredients_en: green beans (2 handfuls) | 1 onion, chopped into pieces the size of your thumbnail | 2-3 cloves garlic, peeled and chopped into small pieces (optional) | 2 cups of canned, chopped tomatoes with juices | 1 large spoon of vegetable oil | pinch of pepper or other seasonings
steps_en: Wash the beans and cut off the ends; boil, steam, or microwave the beans. | Heat the oil in a pan and add the onions. Cook until onions soften. Add garlic and cook for another 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally. | Add green beans, tomatoes, and seasonings; mix thoroughly. | Cover and cook for 5 minutes.

ingredients_en: green beans (2 handfuls) | 2 large spoons vegetable oil | 1 onion, peeled, cut into wedges | 2-3 garlic cloves, peeled and chopped (optional) | 3 large spoons vinegar | 2 small spoons sugar | pinch of salt and pepper
steps_en: Wash the beans and cut off the ends; steam, boil, or microwave the beans. | In a dish, combine vinegar and sugar and stir with a fork to mix. | In a frying pan, heat vegetable oil and add the onions; cook until onions soften. | Add the garlic and cook for another 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally. | Add the green beans to the pan, along with vinegar mixture and seasonings; cook, stirring, for 1-2 minutes.

title_en: Chicken with Green Beans and Vegetables
ingredients_en: green beans (4 handfuls) | 4 chicken breasts, off the bone | 1 onion, peeled and sliced | 2-4 cloves garlic, peeled and sliced or chopped (optional) | 3-4 zucchini or other soft-skinned squash, ends cut off and cut into rounds as thick as a pencil (optional) | 5-6 mushrooms, cut into wedges (optional) | 2-3 large spoons vegetable oil | 1-2 large cans of diced tomatoes or whole tomatoes cut into halves | salt, pepper, or other seasonings
steps_en: Wash the beans and cut off the ends; steam, boil, or microwave the beans. | Remove chicken from the bone; cut into pieces the size of your finger or thumb; sprinkle pieces all over with salt and pepper. | In a large frying pan, heat the oil and add chicken pieces; cook and stir until they are no longer pink, 2-3 minutes. | Then add onion, garlic squash, and mushroom, with a pinch of salt and pepper. Stir often until vegetables soften. | Stir in tomatoes and enough juices for the moistness you want; bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes; stir a couple times. | Stir in cooked green beans; cook another minute.

ingredients_en: green beans (4 handfuls) | 1 onion (optional) | 3 large spoons barbecue sauce | 1 large spoon vegetable oil
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Wash the beans and cut off the ends. | Peel onion, cut off both ends, cut into wedges. | In a large frying pan, heat vegetable oil and add the onion. | Cook the onion until soft and lightly browned, 5-10 minutes. | Add green beans and barbecue sauce; stir 2-3 minutes. | Place mixture in a baking dish; bake for 15-20 minutes.

title_es: Pollo a la Mostaza con Ejotes
ingredients_en: 2 chicken breasts, on the bone | 2 large spoons mustard | 2 small spoons of honey | 2 handfuls of green beans, one per serving | pepper and salt | 4 sheets of aluminum foil (each about 8 inches x 8 inches in size)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. | Wash the beans and cut off the ends. | Mix mustard, honey, and 2 pinches of pepper. | Wash chicken pieces. Trim extra fat and ribs, and discard. Pat pieces dry and lightly sprinkle chicken pieces with salt and coat with mustard mixture. | Put each chicken breast on a sheet of aluminum foil. | Put a handful of green beans on top of each piece of chicken. | Place second sheet of foil on top; bring foil sides together and crinkle all sides creating a packet with room at the top for circulation. | Place packets on top of baking sheets and bake for approximately 30 minutes. | Also can be made with chicken thighs and drumsticks; cook for 35-40 minutes.

ingredients_en: 3 large spoons of vegetable oil | 1 large onion, thinly sliced | 1 pound of greens (spinach, chard, kale, mustard, collard, or turnip) | 1 large spoon lemon juice | salt and pepper (optional)
steps_en: Heat oil in large frying pan. | Add onions and stir until brown. | Add greens and stir for just a minute or two, until greens are soft. | Add lemon juice and stir. | Remove from heat and add salt or pepper, to taste.

title_es: Papas y Cebollas en el Microondas
ingredients_en: 6 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into slices the width of a pencil | 2 onions, peeled and cut into slices the width of a pencil | ½ cup butter or margarine | salt and pepper (optional)
steps_en: Layer potatoes and onions in a microwave dish. | Add a pinch of salt or pepper. | Add butter or margarine on top. | Cover and microwave at normal setting for 15 minutes; stop every 5 minutes and stir.

ingredients_en: 4 baby bok choy | 2 medium onions, chopped | 1 cup green beans, cut into one-inch pieces (optional) | 1-2 small spoons soy sauce | salt or pepper (optional) | vegetable oil or cooking spray
steps_en: Cut the white part of the bok choy into one-inch pieces. | Coarsely chop the green part of the bok choy. Keep the white and the greens separate. | Heat a pan and add a small amount of oil or spray with vegetable oil. | Cook the bok choy white stems, onions, and green beans over medium high heat for 6-7 minutes. | Add bok choy greens and cook one minute longer. | Add soy sauce and stir several times. Season to taste.

ingredients_en: 2 onions | water | salt or pepper to taste
steps_en: Boil a pot of water, enough so that the onions will be covered. | Cut the ends off and peel the onions. | Cut onions into halves. | Boil onions for 10-20 minutes, until tender. | Drain the water. | Season with salt and pepper to taste.

ingredients_en: 4 large or 6 medium onions | ½ stick of butter or margarine, melted | 4 large spoons vinegar | 4 large spoons boiling water | 4 large spoons sugar
steps_en: Grease medium-sized baking dish with small amount of margarine or butter. | Slice onions and arrange in the baking dish. | Mix the melted margarine or butter with vinegar, boiling water, and sugar. Pour this mixture over the onions. | Bake at 300 degrees for 1 hour, stirring several times during baking.

ingredients_en: 6 medium onions, sliced | 3 large spoons vegetable oil | noodles for 4-6 people | 4 large spoons chicken or vegetable broth | handful of fresh parsley (optional) | parmesan cheese to taste (optional) | pepper (optional)
steps_en: Heat oil and add onions to frying pan. | Cover pan and cook on low heat for 20 minutes or until onions are soft. | Cook noodles according to package. | Remove pan cover and turn heat up to medium. | Add broth to pan and stir. | Cook until most of the liquid is gone and onions are brown, 5-10 minutes. | Add parsley and pepper (optional) and stir. | Pour over noodles and add parmesan cheese to taste.

ingredients_en: 1 cucumber, sliced thin | ½ onion, sliced thin | 1 large spoon vinegar | 2 ½ large spoons water | 2 large spoons sugar | pinch of salt and pepper (optional)
steps_en: Slice cucumbers and onions. | Mix vinegar, water, sugar, salt and pepper. Add mixture to cucumbers and onions. | Cover tightly with plastic wrap or store in airtight containers. Refrigerate 8 hours.

ingredients_en: 2 large onions | 1 large spoon honey | 2 small spoons butter or margarine
steps_en: Melt butter on stove top or in microwave and mix with honey. | Peel onions, cut and half, and place cut side up on a microwave safe dish. | Pour honey mixture over the onions. | Cover with wax paper, lid, or plastic wrap. | Microwave on high for 6-8 minutes, stopping every few minutes to spoon juices over the onions and to rotate dish.

ingredients_en: 2 small spoons butter or margarine | 1 large spoon honey | 2 large onions
steps_en: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. | Melt butter or margarine in a small pan. Add honey to the butter or margarine and mix together. | Peel the onions and cut in half. | Place, cut side up, in a baking dish that has been lightly coated with oil or non-stick spray. Or, you can line the dish with foil. | Pour the honey mixture over the onions. | Bake for 60 minutes, turning onions over twice.

ingredients_en: 1 large onion, sliced | 2 carrots, chopped | 1 medium zucchini, sliced (optional) | 1 celery stalk, chopped (optional) | 1 bell pepper, sliced (optional) | 2 large spoons vegetable oil | 1-2 garlic cloves, chopped | salt and pepper to taste | any cooked meat, cut into pieces (optional) | rice (optional)
steps_en: Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Add the carrots and onions. Keeping the heat at medium to high, cook and stir the vegetables for about 5 minutes. | Add the garlic and the rest of the vegetables, any combination you want. If the pan is not big enough to hold all of the vegetables, you can cook them one at a time then mix together. | Cook until the vegetables are soft and slightly crunchy. You may add a spoonful of water to help them cook faster. | Add cooked meat and stir for 1 minute (optional). | Add salt and pepper to taste. | Serve on rice, cooked according to package.

ingredients_en: 4 chicken breasts, cut into pieces | 2 onions, sliced thickly | 2 garlic cloves, chopped (optional) | 2 large spoons vegetable oil | 1 large carrot, peeled and cut into thumb size pieces (optional) | 2-3 zucchini, cut into thick slices (optional) | about ½ can chicken broth | salt and pepper
steps_en: Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees. | Season chicken pieces with salt and pepper. | Coat inside of baking dish with oil. | Arrange chicken pieces skin side up (or you may remove skins), and bake for 15 minutes. | Combine onions, garlic, carrots and zucchini with oil in a bowl. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and pepper and toss to coat. | Add vegetables and half the chicken broth to the baking dish with chicken pieces. | Cover tightly with foil and bake for 30 minutes. | Uncover, add remaining chicken broth, and bake uncovered 5-10 minutes longer, or until chicken juices run clear when you poke pieces with a knife.

ingredients_en: 2-3 large onions | 2 potatoes | 1 large spoon vegetable oil or margarine | salt and pepper (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Peel and slice onions into small pieces the size of the end of your thumb. | Wash potatoes and leave the skins. Cut potatoes into pieces the size of your thumb. | Toss onions and potatoes in a bowl with oil or melted margarine and a pinch of salt and pepper. | Spread onions and potatoes on an oiled baking pan or pan lined with foil. The vegetables should be in a single layer. | Cover with foil and bake for 50 minutes. | Remove foil and bake another 10 minutes until brown.

ingredients_en: 2-3 large onions | 2 large spoons vegetable oil, margarine, or butter | 2 garlic cloves, peeled and sliced (optional) | salt and pepper (optional)
steps_en: Peel and chop or slice onions. | Add salt and pepper to taste (optional). | Heat frying pan on low. Add oil, butter or margarine to pan (Note: Butter or margarine provide more flavor than oil. If using butter or margarine, add 1 large spoon of oil to prevent butter from burning). | Add onions to pan. | Cook on low heat and stir constantly. | Cook until lightly browned for about 10 to 15 minutes. Add garlic. The longer the onions cook, the sweeter they get.

ingredients_en: 5 medium onions, peeled and sliced | water | salt, pepper, or other favorite seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Bring 1 inch of water in a pot to boil. | Place steamer basket in the pot and put sliced onions in basket. | Cover, cook for 5 to 12 minutes (the thicker the slices, the longer they need to be steamed). | Remove onions from steamer, drain. | Season with salt, pepper, or other favorite seasonings.

ingredients_en: 5 medium onions, cut into large pieces | 2 large spoons water or broth | salt, pepper, or other favorite seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Put onion pieces in a microwavable dish. | Add water or broth. | Cover dish with a lid or wax paper. | Cook for 5 to 7 minutes turning dish once during cooking. | Add salt, pepper, or other favorite seasonings.

title_es: Cebollas en Olla Eléctrica Tipo "Crock Pot"
ingredients_en: 5-6 onions, sliced | 3 large spoons butter or margarine, melted | 1 teaspoon salt
steps_en: Combine onions, butter or margarine, and salt in a CrockPot. | Cover and cook on low for 8 hours. | Serve as a side dish with any other vegetables, meat, or fish.

title_es: Cebollas Picantes en Jugo de Limón
ingredients_en: ½ cup lime juice | ½ cup orange juice | 3 large red or brown onions, sliced | 1-2 small spoons of salt
steps_en: Mix lime juice and orange juice in a bowl. | Place the onions in a glass or ceramic bowl. Cover the onions with boiling water and wait 30 seconds. | Drain the onions thoroughly. | Return the onions to the bowl and pour on the juices and stir in the salt. | Cover. Let the onion mixture sit in the refrigerator for 8 hours. | Before serving, drain the onions.

ingredients_en: 2 large onions | ½ cup flour | 2-3 eggs, lightly beaten | 1 cup bread crumbs (seasoned, or add pinches of salt and pepper to plain bread crumbs) | 1 large spoon vegetable oil
steps_en: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. | Coat a cookie sheet with vegetable oil. | Slice the onions as wide as your finger, and separate into rings. | In one bowl, place the flour. Put eggs in a second bowl. Place bread crumbs in a third bowl. | Coat all the onion rings lightly with flour, to dry them. | Dip each ring individually in egg mixture, to coat. Then coat with bread crumbs. Pat so the crumbs will stick to all surfaces. Spread rings out on a plate. | Heat the oiled cookie sheet in the oven for 4-6 minutes. | Carefully, pull sheet out, place onion rings onto heated sheet, making sure none are touching. Bake for 8 minutes. | Remove sheet, turn rings over, and bake for another 8 minutes.

title_es: Estofado de Carne y Papa en Olla Tipo "Crock-Pot"
ingredients_en: 2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into same-size chunks | 3 large spoons vegetable oil | 1 onion, chopped (optional) | 3 stalks of celery or 3 peeled carrots, or both, chopped (optional) | 4 potatoes, peeled and cut into medium chunks | pinch of salt and pepper | pinch of garlic powder (optional) | 1 can condensed tomato soup or 2 cans tomato sauce | water
steps_en: Brown beef in oil in a frying pan. | Add onions and celery or carrots (optional) and cook until tender. | Mix meat, onion mixture, and potatoes in a large bowl. | Add the tomato soup and a soup can of water to the mixture and mix well. | Add seasonings and stir. | Put mixture into the CrockPot. | Cook on high for 4 hours.

ingredients_en: 2 medium potatoes, peeled and grated, squeezed dry in a towel | 3 green onions, finely chopped | 1 egg, beaten lightly | 1/3 cup breadcrumbs or flour | 4 large spoons of vegetable oil | pinch of salt and pepper | Sauce: | 1 clove garlic, chopped finely | 1 green onion, finely chopped | 4 large spoons low-salt soy sauce | 2 large spoons white vinegar | pinch of sugar
steps_en: Mix grated potatoes, green onions, egg, and breadcrumbs (or flour) in a bowl. | Form into patties. | Heat a large spoon of oil in a frying pan; when hot, cook patties on each side, about 5-10 minutes turning once. They should be lightly browned. | Drain the patties on paper towel. | For dipping sauce, combine garlic, green onion, soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar in a dish, and mix well.

ingredients_en: 1 potato per person | water | salt, pepper, seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Wash potatoes under cold water. | Cut the potatoes into medium-sized chunks, the width of your thumb. | Fill a pot with cold water and add potatoes. Bring to a boil. | Cover loosely and cook for 15 minutes. | Test the potatoes with a fork to make sure they are soft, but not falling apart. | Drain the potatoes. | Add salt, pepper, or other seasonings. | You can also mash the cooked potatoes and season to taste.

ingredients_en: 1 potato per person | salt, pepper, seasonings (optional) | non-fat, plain yogurt or salsa (optional) | vegetable oil (optional)
steps_en: Set the oven temperature to 400 degrees. | Wash potatoes under cold water. Stick the potatoes all over with a fork or sharp knife. | Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until soft. | Lightly coating the potato with vegetable oil before cooking will make the potato skin crispy. | Add seasonings or other toppings, if desired. | You can also mash the cooked potatoes and season to taste.

ingredients_en: 1 potato per person | salt, pepper, seasonings (optional) | non-fat, plain yogurt or salsa (optional)
steps_en: Wash potatoes under cold water. Stick the potatoes all over with a fork or sharp knife. | If cooking only one potato, place it in the center of the microwave on a paper towel. | Microwave one potato on high power for 5 minutes or more, turning the potato once during cooking. Remove and let stand for about 2 minutes. | If cooking more than one, place the potatoes at least one inch apart. | Cook two potatoes for about 12 minutes; three potatoes for about 15 minutes; four potatoes for about 18 minutes. Cook until soft. Remove potatoes from the microwave and let stand for about 2 minutes before serving. | Add seasonings or other toppings, if desired. | You can also mash the cooked potatoes and season to taste.

ingredients_en: 3-4 potatoes (peeled or unpeeled) | 4-6 cloves of garlic, peeled (optional) | ½ cup low-fat plain yogurt, or low-fat buttermilk, or low-fat milk (optional) | salt, pepper, herbs, chopped chives, green onion (optional)
steps_en: Wash potatoes under cold water. | Cut potatoes into medium-size chunks. | Fill a pot with cold water and add potatoes. Add a couple of pinches of salt and garlic. Bring to a boil and cook until soft, 15-20 minutes. | Drain the potatoes and garlic. | Use a potato masher or large fork to mash the potatoes and garlic together. | Add yogurt or buttermilk or milk, if you like. | Season with a pinch of salt and pepper, chopped chives, green onion, or other seasonings. | Do not freeze leftovers if you add yogurt, buttermilk, or milk.

ingredients_en: 2 medium potatoes | ½ cup shredded, low-fat cheese | ¾ cup low-fat milk | vegetable oil | salt, pepper, or other seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Wash potatoes under cold water. | Slice unpeeled potatoes into ¼ inch thick slices. | Lightly coat a baking dish with vegetable oil. | Lightly toss potato slices with oil and seasonings. | Place potatoes in baking dish, using two layers if needed. | Sprinkle with cheese, between layers and on top. | Add milk so that it barely covers the potatoes. | Bake in 350 degree oven until soft, about one hour.

ingredients_en: 4 potatoes, washed | ½ cup chopped onion | ½ cup chopped celery | 2 eggs, hard boiled and peeled (optional) | ½ cup low-fat mayonnaise or low-fat, plain yogurt | 1 large spoon mustard | salt or pepper, to taste (optional)
steps_en: Boil or microwave whole potatoes until soft; let potatoes cool and cut them into chunks; sprinkle with salt or pepper, to taste. | Chop onions and celery. | Cook eggs in almost boiling water for 15 minutes; cool under cold running water, peel, and chop. | In a bowl, mix potatoes with onion, celery, and eggs. | Combine mayonnaise or yogurt with mustard, to make dressing. | Add dressing to the potato mixture and stir until all ingredients are coated. | Refrigerate before serving.

ingredients_en: 3 medium potatoes | 2 onions, chopped | 4 celery stalks, chopped (optional) | 3-4 cloves of garlic, chopped (optional) | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | low-fat milk or chicken broth (optional) | 1 can of corn or a package frozen corn (thawed) | pinch of salt and pepper | 4 large spoons of flour
steps_en: Wash potatoes under cold water. | Peel and slice the potatoes as thick as a pencil. | Put oil in pot on low heat. Add potatoes, onions, celery, and garlic. Sprinkle with flour and cook for 5 minutes, until vegetables are soft. | Add water to cover the vegetables and bring to a boil. | Boil until potatoes begin to fall apart, about 20 minutes. | Add a can of corn (drained), or a small package of frozen corn (thawed). | Milk or broth may be added. | Season with salt and pepper.

ingredients_en: 1 potato per person | 2 large spoons of vegetable oil | salt and pepper (optional)
steps_en: Wash potatoes under cold water. | Peel the potatoes and cut into slices, thick as a pencil. | Bring about 1 inch of water to a boil in a pot. | Place a steamer in the pot and place the potatoes in the steamer loosely. | Cover the pot loosely and steam for 12-15 minutes. | Heat the oil in a pan; transfer potatoes to pan, sprinkle with seasonings, and cook, turning often until crispy and golden brown.

ingredients_en: 1 potato per person, peeled or unpeeled | water | salt or pepper or other seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Wash potatoes under cold water. | Cut the potatoes into slices, as thick as a pencil. | Bring about 1 inch of water to a boil in a pot. | Place a steamer in the pot and place the potatoes in the steamer, loosely. | Cover the pot loosely and steam for 15-20 minutes, or until tender. | Season with salt or pepper to taste, or use other seasonings. | You can also mash the cooked potatoes and season to taste.

title_es: Papas Asadas al Horno con Verduras
ingredients_en: 2 potatoes | 3 large spoons vegetable oil | onions, carrots, garlic, other root vegetables, or a combination of vegetables | salt, pepper, or other seasonings
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Wash potatoes under cold water. Cut into medium-sized chunks. | Peel onions and cut into wedges. Cut other vegetables into chunks. | Toss vegetables with 2 large spoons of oil, a pinch of salt and pepper, and other seasonings. | Coat the inside of a baking dish with 1 large spoon of oil. | Bake for 55 minutes to 1 hour or until tender, turning several times; to reduce time, cut potatoes into smaller pieces. | Add unpeeled garlic cloves (tossed in oil and seasonings) halfway through cooking, if you wish.

title_en: Potatoes with Cooked Spinach or Greens
title_es: Papas con Espinacas o Berzas Cocidas
ingredients_en: 4 potatoes | 1-2 bunches of spinach or other greens | 2 large spoons of oil | 1-4 cloves garlic, peeled and sliced (optional) | 2 tomatoes, chopped into small pieces (optional) | salt or pepper or other seasonings | ground beef, turkey, o pork (optional)
steps_en: Wash potatoes thoroughly. | Fill a pot with cold water and a couple pinches of salt. Bring to a boil. Add whole potatoes and cook for about 25 minutes, until tender. | Drain potatoes and cut them into chunks. | To cook the spinach or greens, drop leaves into a large pot of boiling water and cook 1-2 minutes. Drain. | Add oil to a large frying pan and cook garlic for just 1 minute. Add potatoes and cook until slightly brown. Add tomatoes and cooked greens to the pan. | Add ground meat and cook until browned, stirring occasionally (optional). | Cook over medium heat for 5-10 minutes, until mixed and heated. | Add seasonings to taste.
