ingredients_en: 3 potatoes | 1 can chili, fat-free, if possible | salsa or hot sauce (optional) | low-fat shredded cheese (optional) | chopped onion (optional)
steps_en: Bake the potatoes in the oven, microwave, or toaster oven until soft. | Cool potatoes and cut into cubes. | Mix the potatoes and the chili together; add salsa or hot sauce, if desired. | Heat in 350 degree oven for 15-20 minutes, or in the microwave on high for 5 minutes until hot. | Top with cheese, onion, or other extras (optional).

title_en: Potatoes Topped with Beans and Salsa
title_es: Papas Rematadas con Frijoles y Salsa
ingredients_en: 1 potato per person | 1 can beans (black, pinto, or kidney beans) | 1 jar salsa | low-fat sour cream or low-fat, plain yogurt (optional) | Shredded cheese (optional)
steps_en: Bake the potatoes in the oven, microwave, or toaster oven. | Drain can of beans and combine with an equal amount of salsa. Put in a saucepan and heat until warm. | Serve the bean-salsa mixture over the potato. | Top with sour cream, yogurt, or shredded cheese.

title_es: Papas y Pollo al Horno - Todo un Platillo
ingredients_en: 2-3 potatoes | 2-3 large spoons vegetable oil | 4 chicken breast halves, without bone (remove skin, if you wish) | 1 cup shredded cheese, any kind | 1 cup salsa or chopped tomatoes | salt, pepper or other favorite seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. | Line a baking dish with aluminum foil. | Cut potatoes into slices as thick as a pencil; pat dry and toss potatoes lightly with 1-2 large spoons of oil and a pinch of salt, pepper, or other favorite seasonings. | Spread the potatoes in the baking dish and bake for 12 minutes. | Remove pan from the oven and move the potatoes to the sides of the dish. | Rub chicken breasts with a 1-2 large spoons of oil and a pinch of salt or pepper or other seasonings; place chicken in the baking dish. | Bake for 20 minutes or until the chicken is no longer pink inside. | In a small bowl, combine the cheese with salsa or chopped tomatoes; sprinkle this mixture over the cooked chicken. | Bake for another 5 minutes or so, until the cheese is melted.

title_es: Guiso de Papa, Carne y Elote
ingredients_en: 4 potatoes | milk | 1 large spoon of vegetable oil | 1 onion, chopped | 3-4 cloves of chopped garlic (optional) | 2 pounds ground beef, turkey or pork | 2 cans of cream-style corn | salt and pepper or other seasonings
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Peel potatoes and steam or boil them. | Mash potatoes, adding salt, pepper, or seasonings and a bit of milk, so that the potatoes will spread easily. | Heat oil in a pan, cook onion and garlic for 2-3 minutes. | Add meat and brown for 3-5 minutes. Drain the fat, and place mixture in bottom of a greased baking dish. | Cover the meat mixture with the corn. | Spread the mashed potatoes on top of the corn. | Bake 30 minutes at 350 degrees, or until the potatoes are light brown.

title_en: Mashed Potatoes with Turnips (or Rutabagas or Parsnips)
title_es: Puré de Papas con Nabos (o Colinabos o Pastinacas)
ingredients_en: 2 turnips or 2 rutabagas or 3-4 parsnips, peeled and cut into small pieces | 1-2 large spoons butter or margarine | 1 potato, peeled and cut into small pieces | 1 cup shredded cheese or ¼ cup plain yogurt, (optional) | salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings, to taste
steps_en: Place the pieces in a steamer basket and steam for about 10-15 minutes or drop the pieces into boiling water and cover, simmering for approximately 5-8 minutes, until tender when pierced with a fork. | When pieces are soft enough to mash, place them in a bowl and blend with a potato masher. Add butter or margarine, cheese, yogurt, and seasonings. Add small amounts of water or low-fat milk if mixture is too thick. | Do not freeze if you add milk, cheese, or yogurt.

title_en: Boiled Turnips or Rutabagas or Parsnips
title_es: Nabos o Colinabos o Pastinacas Hervidos
ingredients_en: 2 turnips or 2 rutabagas or 3-4 parsnips | water | salt, pepper, other favorite seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Peel and cut off the ends of the turnips (or rutabagas or parsnips). Cut into chunks. | Drop the turnips (or rutabagas or parsnips) into boiling water, cover, and cook approximately 5-8 minutes, until soft. | Drain and season to taste.

title_en: Microwaved Rutabagas or Turnips or Parsnips
title_es: Colinabos o Nabos o Pastinacas Preparados en un Horno de Microondas
ingredients_en: 2 turnips or 2 rutabagas or 3-4 parsnips | 3 large spoons of water or broth | salt, pepper, other herbs or spices (optional)
steps_en: Wash, peel and cut off the ends of the rutabagas or turnips or parsnips. | Cut vegetables into pieces and place in a microwavable dish with the water or broth. | Cover with plastic wrap and cook on high. | Rutabagas (in photo) cook 5 minutes; turnips cook 3 minutes; parsnips cook 3 minutes. | Season to taste.

title_en: Steamed Rutabagas or Turnips or Parsnips
title_es: Colinabos o Nabos o Pastinacas Preparados al Vapor
ingredients_en: 2 rutabagas or 2 turnips or 3-4 parsnips | water | salt, pepper, other favorite seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Peel and cut off the ends of the rutabagas (or turnips or parsnips). | Put water in a pot so that it does not touch the steamer basket. Bring water to a boil. | Cut rutabagas into pieces and place in a steamer basket. | Place the steamer into pot and cover loosely. | Cook on high for approximately 10-15 minutes, until tender. | Season with salt, pepper, other favorite seasonings (optional).

title_en: Baked Turnips or Rutabagas or Parsnips with Ginger
title_es: Nabos o Colinabos o Pastinacas con Jengibre al Horno
ingredients_en: 3 turnips (or 4 parsnips or 3 rutabagas or a combination) peeled and each cut into small chunks | 1 large spoon brown sugar | 3 small spoons butter or margarine, melted | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | 1 small spoon of fresh ginger, finely chopped
steps_en: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. | Coat baking sheet with vegetable oil. | Combine melted butter or margarine, sugar, and ginger in a bowl. | Add turnips (or parsnips or rutabagas or a combination) to the butter or margarine mixture and toss. | Place on baking sheet and cook for 35 minutes or until tender, stirring every 15 minutes.

title_en: Maple Glazed Turnips or Rutabagas or Parsnips
title_es: Nabos o Colinabos o Pastinacas Glaseados con Miel de Maple (Arce)
ingredients_en: 4 turnips or 4 rutabagas or 6-8 parsnips (or a mixture of the vegetables) | 2 large spoons butter or margarine, divided | 3 large spoons maple syrup | ¼ small spoon ground cinnamon (optional) | salt and pepper | 2 small spoons fresh lemon juice (optional)
steps_en: Wash and peel the turnips (or rutabagas or parsnips) and cut into bite-sized pieces. | Heat 1 large spoon of the butter or margarine in a frying pan over medium heat. | Add the maple syrup, cinnamon, salt and pepper and stir. | Add the vegetables and then add 2 large spoons of water. | Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to medium and steam until turnips are tender, about 7-8 minutes. | Uncover and continue to cook until the liquid has reduced and the turnip pieces are glazed with the syrup and spices, about 3 more minutes. | Add the remaining margarine along with the lemon juice. Shake the pan to coat the turnips evenly.

title_en: Roast Chicken with Parsnips (or Turnips or Rutabagas) in Mustard Sauce
title_es: Pollo Asado con Pastinacas (o Nabos o Colinabos) en Salsa de Mostaza
ingredients_en: 6-8 parsnips (or 4-5 turnips or 4-5 rutabagas or a combination) peeled and cut into chunks | 2 onions, peeled and cut into wedges | 6-8 carrots, peeled and cut into chunks (optional) | 2/3 cup mustard | 2/3 cup vegetable oil | favorite herbs or spices (optional) | 1 roasting chicken, rinsed inside and out and patted dry | salt and pepper
steps_en: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Cook chicken and vegetables in two different pans. | Mix mustard, oil, and herbs or spices in bowl. | Rub chicken with pepper. Brush inside and out with half of mustard mixture. Place breast down in an oiled roasting pan and cook. | After 15 minutes, turn chicken on its back and continue roasting until done, about 1 hour total. | Meanwhile, brush another baking sheet with oil. | Toss onions, parsnips (or turnips or rutabagas), and carrots with remaining mustard mixture in bowl. | Spread vegetables on oiled baking sheet. | After chicken has been in the oven for 20-30 minutes, put vegetables in the oven and cook until tender and beginning to brown, turning once. Cook about 30-40 minutes total. | Transfer chicken to platter and serve with vegetables.

ingredients_en: 2 turnips, 2 parsnips, 2 rutabagas (or any combination of the vegetables), peeled and cut into bite-sized chunks | 1 onion, cut into bite-sized chunks (optional) | 2 carrots, peeled and cut into bite-sized chunks (optional) | 1 large spoon margarine or butter, melted | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Lightly coat a baking dish with cooking spray or oil. | Keep the parsnips in a separate bowl and mix with a little oil and melted butter or margarine and seasonings. | In another bowl, mix all of the other vegetables together with oil and melted butter or margarine and seasonings. | Place the rutabagas, turnips, and other vegetables into the baking dish and cook for about 10 minutes. | Add the parsnips to the baking dish and continue cooking for another 15 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and brown. Stir once or twice, while cooking.

title_en: Turnips (or Rutabagas or Parsnips) with Green Beans and Peas
title_es: Nabos (o Colinabos o Pastinacas) con Ejotes y Chícharos
ingredients_en: 2 turnips (or 3 parsnips or 2 rutabagas or a combination), cut into slices or chunks | ¼ cup vegetable oil | 2 large spoons vinegar | ½ small spoon salt | 1 pound slender green beans, trimmed, cut in half | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: Mix oil, vinegar, and salt in medium bowl to make a sauce. Set aside. | Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add turnips (or rutabagas or parsnips) and cook about 10-12 minutes. Then, add green beans and cook an additional 3-4 minutes. Vegetables should be crisp. Drain. | Heat sauce in a large frying pan over low heat until warm. | Add turnips, beans, and peas. Toss until heated through and coated with sauce, about 5 minutes. | Season to taste with additional salt and pepper.

title_en: Mashed Rutabagas (or Turnips or Parsnips) with Garlic
title_es: Puré de Colinabos (o Nabos o Pastinacas) con Ajo
ingredients_en: 5-6 parsnips or 3 turnips or 3 rutabagas, peeled and cut into small pieces | 1 head of garlic, unpeeled | ¼ cup plain non-fat yogurt (optional) | 23 large spoons butter or margarine, melted | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | salt or pepper, to taste
steps_en: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. | Cut off tip of garlic head and discard. Place head in small baking dish, pour a little oil on the garlic, sprinkle with pepper, and bake for 40 minutes. Cool the garlic head. Squeeze the garlic into a small dish. | Drop rutabagas (or turnips or parsnips) into a pot of boiling water. Cook until very tender, about 10 minutes. Drain. | Combine vegetables in bowl with garlic, yogurt, butter or margarine, and salt or pepper. | Blend with a potato masher, or use an electric blender. Add small amounts of water or milk if mixture is too thick. | Do not freeze if you add yogurt.

title_en: Beef with Rutabagas (or Turnips or Parsnips)
title_es: Carne con Colinabos (o Nabos o Pastinacas)
ingredients_en: 2 rutabagas (or 2 turnips or 4 parsnips or a combination) peeled and cut into small cubes | 2 (¼-inch) slices of peeled fresh ginger root, finely chopped | 1 large spoon of vegetable oil | 1 pound boneless beef, cut into small cubes | ½ cup water | 1 large spoon soy sauce | 1 small spoon sugar | 2 pinches of salt | cooked rice or noodles (optional)
steps_en: Cook ginger in oil over low heat for 1-2 minutes. | Add meat and cook over high heat 3-4 minutes and stir occasionally. | Add rutabagas (or turnips or parsnips), cook for 5-8 minutes, stirring occasionally. | Stir in water, soy sauce, sugar, and salt and bring to a boil for 1 minute. | Turn heat down to low and cook for 5 minutes. | Serve over rice or noodles (optional).

title_en: Potato and Turnip (or Rutabaga or Parsnip) Pancakes
title_es: Tortitas de Papas y Nabos (o Colinabos o Pastinacas)
ingredients_en: 1 potato, peeled and grated | 1 turnip (or 1 rutabaga or 2 parsnips), peeled and grated | 1 egg | 1/3 cup breadcrumbs or flour | 1 stalk green onions or 1 small onion, chopped (optional) | pinch of salt and pepper | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | applesauce, salsa, non-fat sour cream, or plain yogurt (optional)
steps_en: Mix grated potato and turnips (or rutabagas or parsnips) together. | Squeeze in a paper towel to remove as much moisture as possible. | Add egg, breadcrumbs or flour, onion (optional), salt, and pepper and mix well. | Heat oil in a frying pan. | Form potato mixture into four tightly packed patties. | Cook patties on each side, about 5 minutes, turning once. They should be lightly browned. | Transfer to paper towels to soak up the excess oil. | Serve pancakes with applesauce, salsa, non-fat sour cream, or plain yogurt, if desired.

title_en: Sweet and Spicy Rutabagas or Turnips or Parsnips
title_es: Colinabos Dulces y Picosos (o Nabos o Pastinacas)
ingredients_en: 3 rutabagas (or 4 parsnips or 3 turnips or a combination) peeled and cut into small chunks | 1 large spoon brown sugar | 3 small spoons butter or margarine, melted | pinch of salt | ½ small spoon crushed red pepper flakes (more or less, to taste) | vegetable oil
steps_en: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. | Coat baking sheet with vegetable oil. | Combine melted butter or margarine, sugar, salt and pepper flakes in a bowl. | Add rutabagas (or parsnips or turnips or a combination) to the margarine mixture and toss. | Place on baking sheet and cook for 35 minutes or until tender, stirring every 15 minutes.

title_en: Crock Pot Turnip (or Rutabaga or Parsnip) Casserole
title_es: Guiso en Olla Estilo Crock Pot de Nabos (o Colinabos o Pastinacas)
ingredients_en: 4 turnips (or 3-4 rutabagas, or 6-8 parsnips, or a combination) peeled and cut into small chunks | 1 egg, beaten | 1/3 cup crushed saltines or breadcrumbs | 2/3 cup evaporated milk | pinch of salt (optional) | pinch of pepper (optional) | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
steps_en: Heat pot of water to boiling, add turnips (or rutabagas or parsnips or a combination) and cook until tender, about 15 minutes. | Drain turnips, mash, and drain off any excess liquid. | Stir in beaten egg, saltines, milk, salt and pepper, and cheese. Blend well. | Pour into a buttered or oiled CrockPot. Cook on high for 2 hours.

title_en: Stove-Top Fried Parsnips or Turnips or Rutabagas
title_es: Pastinacas, Nabos o Colinabos Fritos al Sartén
ingredients_en: 3 turnips (or 3 rutabagas or 4-6 parsnips or a combination), peeled and grated | 2-3 large spoons butter, margarine, or vegetable oil | 1-2 large spoons brown sugar | salt and pepper to taste
steps_en: Heat butter, margarine or oil in a pan and fry the turnips (or parsnips or rutabagas or a combination) until they start to get soft. | Season with salt, pepper and brown sugar and continue cooking until tender.

title_en: Rutabaga (or Turnip or Parsnip) and Potato Soup
title_es: Colinabos (o Nabos o Pastinacas) y Sopa de Papa
ingredients_en: 4 turnips (or 3 rutabagas or 4 parsnips or a combination), peeled and cut into chunks | 1 medium onion, chopped | 3 potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 sweet potato, peeled and cut into chunks (optional) | 2 large spoons butter or margarine | 3-4 cups vegetable broth or chicken broth | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: Heat butter or margarine in the bottom of a large pot. Cook onions until soft. | Add turnips (or rutabagas or parsnips) and potatoes to pot. Add broth to 1 inch over the top of the mixture and cook for 15-20 minutes until tender. | If desired, mix in a blender or food processor and add a little more broth. | Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title_en: Parsnip (or Turnip or Rutabaga) Maple Soup
title_es: Sopa de Pastinaca (o Nabo o Colinabo) y Miel de Maple (Arce)
ingredients_en: 3 large spoons butter or margarine | 4 parsnips (or 4 turnips, or 3 rutabagas or combination) peeled and cut into small chunks | 2 medium onions, chopped | 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped (optional) | 3 cups chicken broth or vegetable broth | 1/3 cup maple syrup
steps_en: Heat butter or margarine in the bottom of a large pot. | Add parsnips (or turnips or rutabagas or a combination), onions, and garlic and cook until onions are soft but not brown. | Add broth to cover vegetables. Simmer until vegetables are soft, about 30-40 minutes. | Remove from heat. Blend in a blender or food processor. | Stir in maple syrup.

title_es: Tacos de Pastinaca (o Colinabo o Nabo)
ingredients_en: 4 parsnips (or 3 turnips or 3 rutabagas or a combination) | 1 small spoon mustard | pinch of pepper | cooked chicken or meat (optional) | ½ can low-fat cream of mushroom soup | 2 green onions, chopped (optional) | 6 corn tortillas or taco shells | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | 2 large spoons butter or margarine | 1 cup shredded cheese, any kind | salsa (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease a baking dish. | Grate parsnips (or rutabagas or turnips or a combination) and squeeze water out in a towel. | Heat frying pan and add vegetable oil and butter or margarine. Add vegetables and cook for 15 minutes, on medium heat, until brown. | Combine soup, mustard, and pepper in a large bowl and mix well. | Add vegetables, meat (optional), green onions (optional), ½ cup of cheese. | Spoon some of the mixture into the center of a tortilla. Fold in sides of each tortilla. | Place in a greased baking dish. | Bake for 15 minutes. | Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake 5-10 minutes more. | Serve with salsa (optional).

title_en: Orange-Flavored Parsnips (or Rutabagas or Turnips) and Carrots
title_es: Pastinacas (o Colinabos o Nabos) y zanahorias a la Naranja
ingredients_en: 4 carrots, sliced | 4 parsnips (or 3 turnips or 3 rutabagas or a combination), sliced | ½ cup orange juice | 1 small spoon honey
steps_en: Mix the orange juice and the honey in a pot. Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. | Stir in the vegetables. | Bring to a boil again and simmer, covered, for 10-15 minutes. | Remove cover and continue cooking until the liquid thickens.

title_en: Sweet Baked Turnips (or Rutabagas or Parsnips) and Apples
title_es: Nabos Dulces (o Colinabos o Pastinacas) Horneados con Manzanas
ingredients_en: 6 turnips (or 10 parsnips or 6 rutabagas or a combination) | 2 apples, sliced | 1/3 cup sugar | 1 small spoon cinnamon | ¼ cup flour | 1/3 cup brown sugar | 2 large spoons of butter or margarine
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease a baking dish. | Boil, steam, or microwave the turnips or parsnips or rutabagas. Drain and mash the vegetables. | Spread half of the mashed vegetables in the bottom of the baking dish. | Mix the cinnamon and sugar in a bowl. | Dip the apple slices in the cinnamon and sugar mixture and then place on the layer of mashed vegetables. | Spread the remaining mashed vegetables on top of the apples. | Mix flour, brown sugar and butter (or margarine) together until crumbly. | Sprinkle this flour mixture on top of the casserole. | Bake for 1 hour or until the top is crispy brown.

ingredients_en: sweet potatoes, cut into medium-sized chunks | water | salt, pepper, seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Fill a pot with water. Add sweet potatoes to water and bring to a boil. | Cover loosely and simmer for 15 minutes. | Test the sweet potatoes with a fork to make sure they are soft, but not falling apart. | Drain the sweet potatoes. | Add salt, pepper, or other seasonings. | You can also mash the cooked sweet potatoes and season to taste.

ingredients_en: sweet potatoes | Toppings: | salt, pepper, seasonings (optional) | butter or margarine (optional) | non-fat, plain yogurt or salsa (optional) | vegetable oil (optional)
steps_en: Heat the oven or counter top oven to 350 degrees. | Wash sweet potatoes under cold water. Stick the potatoes all over with a fork or sharp knife. | Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until soft. | Lightly coating the sweet potato with vegetable oil during cooking will make the potato skin crispy. | To serve, slit top of the cooked sweet potato and push ends toward each other. | Add seasonings or other toppings, if desired. (Yogurt cannot be frozen.) | You can also scoop out the insides of the cooked sweet potatoes, mash, and season to taste.

ingredients_en: sweet potatoes | Toppings: | salt, pepper, seasonings (optional) | butter or margarine (optional) | non-fat, plain yogurt or salsa (optional)
steps_en: Wash sweet potato under cold water. Stick the sweet potato all over with a fork or sharp knife. | Place the sweet potato in the center of the microwave on a paper towel or microwavable dish. | Cook on high power for 3-5 minutes, turning the sweet potato once during cooking. | Remove the sweet potato and let stand for about 2 minutes. | To serve, slit top of cooked potato and push ends toward each other. | Add seasonings or other toppings, if desired. (Yogurt cannot be frozen.) | You can also scoop out the insides of cooked sweet potatoes, mash, and season to taste. | If cooking more than one sweet potato: | Place the sweet potatoes at least one inch apart. | Cook two sweet potatoes for about 7 minutes; three sweet potatoes for about 10 minutes; four sweet potatoes for about 13 minutes. Cook until soft. | Remove sweet potatoes from the microwave and let stand for about 2 minutes before serving.

ingredients_en: 2 sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into slices | butter or margarine to taste (optional) | salt or pepper or other seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Bring about 1 inch of water to a boil in a pot. | Place a steamer in the pot and place the sweet potatoes in the steamer, loosely arranged. | Cover the pot loosely and steam for 15-20 minutes, or until tender. | Season with butter or margarine and salt or pepper to taste, or use other seasonings. | You can also mash the cooked sweet potatoes and season to taste.

ingredients_en: 2-3 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into pieces the size of your little finger | outer colored part of peel from one orange (optional) | 1 large spoon chopped garlic | 1 large spoon chopped ginger | 1 large spoon chopped greens from onion tops (optional) | cooked chicken pieces (optional) | Sauce: | ½ cup chicken broth or water | 2 large spoons soy sauce | 1 large spoon vinegar | 1 small spoon sugar | 2 large spoons vegetable oil | pinch of pepper
steps_en: Combine broth or water, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, 1 large spoon of oil, and pepper for sauce. Set aside. | Cut peel from orange, taking only the colored part. Chop into small strips. Set aside. | Heat 1 large spoon of oil in a frying pan that has a cover. | Add orange peel, garlic, ginger and sweet potatoes and cook for 23 minutes. | Add sauce. | Bring to a boil, then cook, covered over medium heat until potatoes are tender, 15-20 minutes. Stir often. | Add chicken and chopped green onions if desired.

title_en: Baked Chicken with Peaches and Sweet Potatoes
title_es: Pollo al Horno con Duraznos y Camotes
ingredients_en: 4 chicken breast halves, with the bone | 3 sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced thinly | salt and pepper | 2 medium onions, thinly sliced (optional) | ½ cup brown sugar, packed | 1 (16 ounce) can of peaches, drained (or 2 cups fresh peaches) | 1 large spoon orange juice or peach liquid from can | 2 cloves garlic, chopped (optional) | 1 large spoon margarine (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. | Rub chicken with salt and pepper. | Spray or oil baking dish and arrange chicken in one layer. | Scatter sweet potatoes, garlic and onions on chicken. | Sprinkle with salt and pepper. | Mix sugar and orange juice, drizzle over chicken and potatoes. | Bake uncovered 30 minutes, basting occasionally. | Add peaches on top and dots of margarine (optional). | Bake uncovered 30 additional minutes or more, basting occasionally, until potatoes are tender and chicken is cooked through.

ingredients_en: 3 sweet potatoes or yams, peeled and cut into medium pieces | 1 onion, peeled and cut into small pieces | 1 small butternut squash, peeled and cut into medium pieces (optional) | 2-3 carrots, peeled and cut into small pieces | 2 cups water or broth | salt and pepper to taste
steps_en: Place all vegetables in a pot. | Cover with water or broth. | Bring to a boil and continue cooking until vegetables are tender. | Mash vegetables until smooth using a large spoon or a potato masher. | Add salt and pepper to taste.

title_es: Camotes Crujientes estilo "Papas Fritas" a la Francesa
ingredients_en: 4 medium sweet potatoes or yams | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | 1 large spoon margarine or butter, melted | pinch of black pepper | pinch of salt | 2-3 cloves garlic, chopped (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. | Cut potatoes into narrow wedges. | Coat a baking sheet with vegetable spray or vegetable oil. | Put the potatoes in a large bowl with garlic. | Add the oil and melted margarine or butter. Stir. | Add pepper and salt. | Place potatoes on baking sheet. | Bake for 20 minutes. | Turn over the potatoes and bake another 20 minutes or until brown and tender.

title_es: Camotes Asados al Horno al Estilo de la Abuela
ingredients_en: 2 sweet potatoes or yams, peeled and cut into small chunks | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | 1 large spoon butter or margarine, melted | pinch of salt | pinch of pepper | 1 chopped onion (optional) | 1 carrot, cut into chunks (optional) | 4 garlic cloves, cut in half (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. | Mix potatoes, optional vegetables and garlic with the oil and melted butter or margarine, sprinkle with salt and pepper. Toss well. | Place the vegetables in a baking dish that has been coated with cooking spray or oil. | Place in oven and bake for 30 minutes.

title_en: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Salad
title_es: Ensalada de Camotes y Frijoles Negros
ingredients_en: 1 sweet potato, peeled and cubed | 2 large spoons fresh lime or lemon juice | 2 large spoons vegetable oil | 1 small spoon mustard | salt and pepper to taste | 1 clove garlic, finely chopped | 3 to 4 stalks green onions, chopped (optional) | 1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
steps_en: Steam or boil sweet potatoes, until tender; drain and let cool. | Combine lime or lemon juice, oil, mustard, salt, pepper, and garlic in a bowl and stir. | Add sweet potato, onions, and beans. Stir well to coat.

ingredients_en: 1 sweet potato, boiled or steamed, sliced and cooled | 1 potato, boiled or steamed, sliced and cooled (optional) | 1 onion, sliced | 3 large spoons oil | salt or pepper or favorite seasoning, to taste
steps_en: Place oil in pan. | Put onions in pan and cook until tender. | Add sweet potatoes, other potatoes and cook for a few minutes. | Add salt or pepper or favorite seasoning.

title_en: Mashed Sweet Potatoes and White Potatoes
title_es: Puré de Camotes y Papas Blancas
ingredients_en: 2 sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 2 white potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks | ¾ cup plain nonfat yogurt, at room temperature | 2 large spoons chopped fresh parsley (optional) | pinch of salt, to taste | pinch of pepper, to taste
steps_en: Boil or steam potatoes until tender. | Drain potatoes and mash. | Add yogurt, parsley, salt and pepper and mix thoroughly.

ingredients_en: 3 sweet potatoes | ½ cup crushed pineapple, drained (more if you like) | 2-3 large spoons packed brown sugar | 3 large spoons butter or margarine | vegetable oil
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease a baking dish with vegetable oil or spray. | Peel the sweet potatoes and cut into cubes. | Fill a pot with water. Add sweet potatoes to water and bring to a boil. | Cover loosely and simmer for 10 minutes, or until tender, but not falling apart. | Drain the sweet potatoes and mix with the crushed pineapple, most of the brown sugar, and margarine or butter and put into the baking dish. | Bake for 20 minutes. | Sprinkle remaining brown sugar on top and broil for 5 minutes (optional).

ingredients_en: 4 sweet potatoes or yams, peeled sliced | 3 large spoons lemon juice | 1 small spoon salt | ½ stick butter or margarine, softened | lemons, sliced thin (optional)
steps_en: Boil or steam potatoes until tender, drain. | Mash potatoes. | Stir in lemon juice, butter or margarine, and salt. | If topping with lemons, put mashed potatoes into a baking dish and top with lemon slices. | Cook at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until heated through. | Cook under broiler for about 3-5 minutes, until top starts to brown (optional).

ingredients_en: 6 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1inch cubes | 1 ½ cups applesauce | ½ cup packed brown sugar | pinch of ground cinnamon (optional) | 3 large spoons butter or margarine, melted
steps_en: Place sweet potatoes in a CrockPot. | Mix remaining ingredients together in a bowl. Pour this mixture over the potatoes and stir gently. | Cover and cook on low heat 4-5 hours or until the sweetpotatoes are very tender. | Mix the sweet potatoes well before serving.

ingredients_en: 4 sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into strips | 2 large spoons vegetable oil | 1 small spoon chili powder or cayenne pepper, or to taste (optional) | 1 large spoon hot pepper sauce, or to taste (optional) | pinch of salt
steps_en: Mix oil, chili powder or cayenne pepper and hot sauce together. | Add sweet potatoes and toss until well coated. | Spread potatoes onto a baking pan coated lightly with cooking spray or vegetable oil. | Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes, turn potatoes and bake another 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender and browned.

ingredients_en: 2-3 sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into cubes the size of your thumbnail | 1 (15 ounce) can black beans, drained | ½ cup chunky salsa
steps_en: Boil potatoes in lightly salted water for 10 minutes, or until tender. | Drain and cool. | Combine the beans, sweet potatoes and salsa. | Serve warm or cold.

ingredients_en: 2 sweet potatoes or yams | ¼ cup low-fat mayonnaise | ½ small spoon mustard | salt and pepper, to taste | 2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced (optional) | ½ cup finely chopped celery | 3 green onions, chopped
steps_en: Boil or steam potatoes until potatoes can be pierced easily with a sharp knife. | Drain the potatoes and cool. | Peel the potatoes and cut into medium-sized chunks. | In a large bowl, combine the mayonnaise, mustard, salt, and pepper. | Add the eggs, celery, and green onions. | Add the potatoes and mix gently. | Cover and refrigerate for 2-4 hours.

ingredients_en: 3 zucchini, cut into small chunks | 1 cup frozen or canned corn | 1 onion, thinly sliced | 1 large spoon butter, margarine, or vegetable oil | salt and pepper, to taste | ½ cup shredded cheese (optional)
steps_en: Thaw frozen corn or drain canned corn. | Put butter, margarine, or oil in a frying pan. | Add onions and corn and cook until onions are clear, but not brown. | Add zucchini, salt, and pepper to taste. | Add about ½ cup of cold water and cover pan. | Cook on medium heat until vegetables are tender, just a few minutes. | Drain any excess water, then add cheese, mix, and cover until the cheese melts.

title_es: Guiso de Calabacitas y Carne Molida
ingredients_en: ½ pound hamburger | 4 zucchini, sliced thick as a pencil | ½ cup green peppers, chopped (optional) | 1 small spoon fresh parsley, chopped (optional) | 1 small onion, chopped | ½ small spoon garlic salt (optional) | 2 tomatoes, peeled and sliced or an 8-ounce can whole tomatoes, sliced | ¼ cup dried breadcrumbs | ¼ cup parmesan cheese
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | In a frying pan, brown hamburger, onion, green peppers, parsley, onion, and garlic salt. | In a baking dish, place layers of meat mixture and zucchini, then meat mixture and zucchini. | Top with tomato slices. | Mix breadcrumbs and Parmesan cheese together and put on top. | Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes. | Bake an additional 5 minutes at 450 degrees or broil for 1-2 minutes if you want a crispier top.

ingredients_en: 3 zucchini, cut into slices | 3 tomatoes, thinly sliced or a can of tomatoes, drained | 1 onion, thinly sliced | ½ cup grated Parmesan cheese | butter, margarine, or vegetable oil | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Lightly grease a casserole dish with butter, margarine, or oil. | Cover the bottom of the casserole dish with half the sliced tomatoes. | Add half the zucchini and onions. | Season with salt and pepper. | Sprinkle with half the Parmesan cheese. | Repeat layer using remaining vegetables. | Top off the casserole with remaining Parmesan cheese. | Bake uncovered for 45 minutes.

ingredients_en: 2 zucchini, ends trimmed | 3 large, heaping spoons of breadcrumbs | 2 large spoons of bell pepper, chopped very small | 1-2 large spoons of grated Parmesan cheese | pinch of salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings | vegetable oil | any cooked meat, finely chopped (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Lightly coat a baking sheet with oil. | Cut the zucchini in half lengthwise. With the tip of a spoon remove zucchini seeds and discard, leaving plenty of the zucchini in the shell. Cut a thin slice from the bottom of each zucchini piece to allow it to sit flat. | Rub the zucchini shells lightly with oil. | Mix together the breadcrumbs, bell pepper, cheese, and seasonings. And, meat, if you wish. | Pat the mixture into the zucchini shells. Top with more cheese, if desired. | Bake, uncovered, for 15 minutes or until brown.

title_en: Stove-Top Chicken with Zucchini and Tomatoes
title_es: Pollo con Calabacitas y Jitomates al Sartén
ingredients_en: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2 zucchini, cut into strips | ½ cup mushrooms, sliced or cut into quarters (optional) | 2 small spoons vegetable oil | 1 can (14 ounces) diced tomatoes | salt or pepper (optional) | cooked noodles or rice (optional)
steps_en: Cut the chicken breast pieces into strips, about the size of a finger. | Heat oil in a frying pan and cook chicken, stirring often, until brown on all sides, 3-5 minutes. | Add zucchini and cook until lightly browned, stirring occasionally, 5-7 minutes. | Add the mushrooms and tomatoes and mix well. Cook another 3-5 minutes. | Serve over noodles or rice, prepared according to the package.

ingredients_en: 2 zucchini, cut into slices | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings
steps_en: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. | Toss zucchini with a large spoon of vegetable oil and a pinch of salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings. | Spread the zucchini on a baking sheet. | Bake for 10 minutes and turn the zucchini. Bake another 10 minutes until brown.

ingredients_en: 3-4 zucchini, cut into cubes | 1 bell pepper, cut into chunks | 6 tortillas | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | a pinch of chili powder (optional) | 1 clove garlic, chopped (optional) | 1 (8 ounce) can enchilada sauce | 1 cup cheese, shredded | cooked chicken or black beans (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Heat oil in a frying pan. Add garlic, zucchini, bell peppers and chili powder and any optional ingredients. | Fry the vegetables until tender, about 5-7 minutes. | Lightly oil a baking dish. | Put zucchini mixture on the tortillas and roll them up. | Place the tortillas in a baking dish and bake for 10 minutes. | Pour enchilada sauce, any extra zucchini mixture, and cheese over the tortillas and bake for 10 more minutes.

title_es: Relleno de Calabacitas como Plato Adicional
ingredients_en: 3 zucchini, ends trimmed and cut into small chunks | ¼ cup onions, finely chopped | 1 cup of bread cubes or stuffing mix | ¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese | 1 large spoon garlic, chopped (optional) | salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings to taste | vegetable oil
steps_en: Lightly coat a casserole dish with vegetable oil or spray. | Combine zucchini, onion, bread cubes or stuffing mix, cheese, garlic, and seasonings to taste and mix well. | Add a bit of vegetable oil, just enough to moisten the mixture. Mix well. | Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 55 minutes. | Let sit 5 minutes before serving.

ingredients_en: 1 package (12 ounce) noodles | 3 zucchini, ends trimmed | 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped (optional) | 2 large spoons vegetable oil | ½ of 14 ½ ounce can diced tomatoes, undrained | salt and pepper, to taste | ½ cup grated Parmesan cheese
steps_en: Cut zucchini lengthwise. Then cut crosswise into pieces that are pencil-wide. | Cook noodles according to directions on the package. | While noodles are cooking, heat a frying pan. Add vegetable oil, garlic, and zucchini and cook until tender, about 10 minutes. Stir occasionally. | Add tomatoes, salt, and pepper to zucchini and stir. | Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring often. | Once the noodles are cooked, drain, and stir into the zucchinitomato mixture. | Top with cheese.

title_en: Stove-Top Zucchini with Onions and Tomatoes
title_es: Calabacitas con Cebollas y Jitomates al Sartén
ingredients_en: 4-5 zucchini, ends trimmed and thickly sliced | 1 onion, chopped | 1 clove garlic, crushed | 1 (14 ½ ounce) can diced tomatoes | 1 large spoon margarine or butter | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: Melt the margarine or butter in a large fry pan. Cook the onion and garlic on medium for 3-7 minutes, until softened but not browned. | Add the tomatoes with their juice, bring to a boil, lower heat, and simmer for 10-15 minutes. | Add the zucchini to the sauce, cover tightly and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until tender. | Stir in the seasoning to taste.

ingredients_en: 2 cucumbers, thinly sliced | 2 zucchini, thinly sliced | 1 small sweet onion, thinly sliced (optional) | 1/3 cup vinegar | ¼ cup sugar | ½ cup hot water | 1 small spoon salt | 1 small spoon pepper | 1 pinch red pepper flakes
steps_en: In a dish, arrange cucumber, zucchini and onions in alternate layers. | Mix vinegar, sugar, and ½ cup hot water, until the sugar is dissolved. | Add salt, pepper, and crushed red pepper to vinegar mixture. | Add two ice cubes to the mix to chill it. | Pour dressing over vegetables and let sit at room temperature for 1 hour before serving. | Mix vegetables and dressing a couple of times while sitting at room temperature.

ingredients_en: 2 zucchini, sliced thick as a pencil | vegetable oil (optional) | salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Put water to fill a pot halfway and bring to a boil. | Add the zucchini and boil until they are soft, about 3-4 minutes. | Drain the zucchini and toss with some vegetable oil and seasonings.

title_es: Calabacitas con Queso Parmesano al Sartén
ingredients_en: 3 zucchini, ends trimmed and cut into strips | 1 small spoon vegetable oil | pinch of lemon zest (optional) | pinch of salt and pepper | 1 large spoon Parmesan cheese
steps_en: In large frying pan, cook zucchini in oil over medium heat for 4 minutes. | Sprinkle with lemon zest (optional), salt, and pepper. | Fry 4-5 minutes longer or until zucchini is crisp. | Remove from heat, and sprinkle with cheese.

title_es: Calabacitas con Jitomates en Olla Eléctrica "Crock Pot"
ingredients_en: 3 cups zucchini, sliced | 1 ½ cups onions, chopped | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | 3 cups of canned diced tomatoes, with liquid | ¼ cup Italian salad dressing | 2 large spoons sugar
steps_en: Heat oil in a frying pan and cook onions for 3-4 minutes. | Combine onions and all the other ingredients in the CrockPot and mix well. | Cover and cook on low for 4 hours. | Can serve over noodles or rice, prepared according to package.

ingredients_en: 4 zucchini, cut into chunks | salt, pepper, or other favorite seasonings
steps_en: Place zucchini in a steamer basket. | Pour just enough water in a pot so that the water will not touch the bottom of the steamer basket. Bring water to boil. Place steamer basket in pot and cover. | Cook for 5-7 minutes or until zucchini are bright green and tender. | Drain and season with salt, pepper, or other favorite seasonings.

ingredients_en: 4 zucchini | 3 tomatoes | ¼ cup Italian salad dressing | garlic powder (optional) | salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings, to taste (optional)
steps_en: Cut zucchini into chunks. | Bring a pot of water, with a pinch of salt, to a boil. Add zucchini pieces and cook for 3 minutes. Drain and immediately put pieces in a bowl of cold water and ice cubes to stop the cooking. Let cool and drain. | Cut tomatoes in half. Remove seeds. Cut into chunks. | Combine zucchini and tomatoes in a bowl. Add Italian salad dressing and mix vegetables to coat them. | Add garlic powder, salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings, to taste (optional), mixing well.

ingredients_en: 3 zucchini, ends trimmed and sliced into rounds | ½ cup onion, chopped (optional) | 1 large spoon margarine or butter, melted (optional) | ¼ small spoon garlic powder (optional) | salt, pepper or favorite seasonings, to taste (optional) | water
steps_en: Put zucchini and onion into a microwave-safe bowl, with 2 large spoons of water. | Microwave on high for 6-8 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes. | Season with garlic powder, salt, pepper, or other optional seasonings, to taste. Blend in melted margarine or butter, if you wish.

ingredients_en: 2 cup zucchini, chopped | ¼ cup chopped onion (optional) | ½ cup shredded cheese | 2 eggs | 5 large spoons Bisquick | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly grease a casserole dish with vegetable oil or spray. | Mix the eggs and the Bisquick together in a large bowl. | Add the zucchini, onions, and cheese. Mix. | Add salt and pepper to taste. | Put into a casserole dish and bake 45 minutes.

ingredients_en: 4 cups sliced zucchini | 2 onions, chopped | 2 large spoon cooking oil | 1 clove garlic (optional) | 2 cups low-salt chicken broth | salt and pepper, to taste (optional)
steps_en: In a pot, heat vegetable oil. | Add chopped onions and garlic and cook until the onions are soft. | Add the zucchini and mix together. | Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil. Simmer until zucchini is soft, 15-20 minutes. | Mix with a potato masher or blender. | Season with salt or pepper to taste. | This soup can be served hot or cold.

ingredients_en: 2 cups zucchini, sliced thick as a pencil | ¼ cup breadcrumbs | ¼ cup Parmesan cheese | pinch of seasoning salt, garlic powder, and pepper (optional) | 1 egg, beaten | vegetable oil or cooking spray
steps_en: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. | Coat a wire rack lightly with vegetable oil or cooking spray. | Combine breadcrumbs, Parmesan cheese, seasonings and mix well. | Place egg in a shallow bowl. | Dip zucchini slices in the egg, and then in the breadcrumb mixture. Cover the zucchini on both sides with the breadcrumb mixture. | Place zucchini slices on the wire rack and put the wire rack on a baking sheet. | Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until brown and crispy.

title_es: Calabacitas y Brotes de Soya Sofritas
ingredients_en: 4 zucchini, cut in half and sliced into strips | 1 onion, sliced (optional) | 6 ounces bean sprouts | 1 tomato, diced (optional) | ¼ pound ground meat or 2 chicken breasts, cut into small chunks (optional) | 1/3 cup chicken broth | soy sauce, to taste | 2 cloves garlic, chopped fine (optional) | 2 large spoons vegetable oil | cooked rice (optional)
steps_en: Heat oil in a frying pan and brown meat or chicken over medium heat, about 3-5 minutes. | Add onions and garlic and cook about 2 minutes. | Add chicken broth and soy sauce and mix well. | Add zucchini and bean sprouts and cook 2 minutes. | Add tomato and cook 1 minute. | Serve with rice, prepared according to package.

title_es: Guiso de Pollo y Verduras Estilo Enchilada
ingredients_en: 2 cups shredded, cooked chicken or cooked ground beef, or cooked ground turkey | 1 large spoon of oil | 2-3 zucchini, diced | 1 onion, diced (optional) | 1 can black beans (optional) | 1 can corn | 2 ½ cups enchilada sauce (or less, to taste) | 6-12 tortillas, depending on size | 3 cups low fat shredded cheese (about 12 oz.) | low fat sour cream (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | In a pan, heat oil over medium heat. Add zucchini and onion and cook until tender, about 8-10 minutes. Add meat, corn and beans and mix well. | In a 9" x 13" baking dish, spread ½ cup of enchilada sauce. | Then, place a layer of tortillas, overlapping, if needed. Add the vegetables/meat mix. Add half of the cheese. | Spread about 1 ½ cup of enchilada sauce on top of the cheese. | Add another layer of tortillas. Spread the remaining enchilada sauce evenly on top of the tortillas. | Bake for 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and top with remaining cheese. Bake for another 5-10 minutes or until cheese is melted and golden brown. | Top with sour cream (optional).

title_en: Broccoli, Corn, Rice, and Chicken/Meat Combo
title_es: Combinación de Brócoli, Elote, Arroz y Pollo/Carne
cook: 40 minutes (Cooking time will be less with instant rice).
ingredients_en: 1 cup un-cooked rice (brown or white) | 1 can creamed corn (14-15 oz.) | 1 head of broccoli, cut into pieces (see “Cutting Tips"), about two cups | Any cooked meat or cooked chicken, 1-2 cups (optional) | Low-fat grated cheese (optional)
steps_en: Cook rice according to instructions on the package. | Cook the broccoli pieces (steam, boil, or microwave). | Mix together broccoli, corn, rice, and meat. | If desired, warm mixture on stove top or in 350 degree oven for 5 minutes. | Top with grated cheese and, if desired, place under broiler until cheese melts. (optional)

title_es: Guisado de Brócoli, Carne, y Fideos
ingredients_en: 1-2 heads of broccoli, cut into bite-size pieces (see "Cutting Tips") | 3-4 cloves of garlic, chopped into small pieces (optional) | 4 large spoons of vegetable oil | 1 package of noodles | salt, pepper or red pepper flakes (optional) | cooked meat or chicken, cut into small pieces | other cooked vegetables (optional) | low-fat shredded cheese, any kind (optional)
steps_en: Boil noodles according to the directions on the package and drain. Save a cup of the boiling water. | Cook the broccoli pieces (steam, boil or microwave). The broccoli should be a bright green and still firm. Test with a fork. | Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat, add garlic (optional) and stir until garlic starts to soften. | Add the broccoli to the pan and stir together. Add a pinch of salt, pepper or red pepper flakes (optional). | Add any other cooked vegetables and cooked meat/chicken. Add noodles, and some of the boiling water for desired consistency. | Serve this way, or with shredded cheese as a topping.

title_en: Broccoli Stir-Fry with Meat or Chicken
title_es: Saltado de Brócoli con Carne o Pollo
ingredients_en: 1 head of broccoli, cut into pieces (see "Cutting Tips") | 2 large spoons of vegetable oil | 2 large spoons of water or broth | 4 cloves of fresh garlic, chopped (optional) | meat or chicken, cut into small pieces | other chopped vegetables, such as carrots, celery, onions, bell peppers or zucchini (optional) | salt and pepper, to taste | low-sodium soy sauce (optional) | Cooked rice or noodles (optional)
steps_en: In a bowl, combine meat or chicken with 1 large spoon of oil, salt, pepper, soy sauce (optional) and mix well. | Heat 1 large spoon oil in a pan until hot. | Add meat or chicken and stir constantly until browned, about 2-3 minutes. Put meat/chicken on a plate. | Add broccoli and any other vegetables to the pan. | Add water or broth. Cover and cook until vegetables are tender, 3-6 minutes, depending on vegetables. | Add meat to the pan and stir for another 1-2 minutes. | Serve over rice or noodles (optional).

ingredients_en: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 onion, chopped | 4 cups zucchini, thinly sliced | 5 eggs, beaten | 3 cups shredded cheese | pinch of salt, pepper, or other favorite seasonings | Any cooked meat or other cooked vegetables (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Lightly grease a 9-inch baking dish. | Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add onions and zucchini and cook until tender, stirring occasionally. Drain. | In a large bowl, combine eggs, cheese, salt, pepper, or other seasonings. Add zucchini/onion mix and blend well. Add meat. | Scoop into prepared pie pan. | Bake until eggs have set, about 30 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

ingredients_en: 2 bunches of broccoli, florets and stems | 2 large spoons of butter or margarine | 3 medium size potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces or | 1 large onion, peeled and chopped into 1-inch pieces | Pinch of salt and pepper | 3 cups chicken or vegetable broth | 1 large spoon flour | 2 hands-full of spinach (optional) | 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
steps_en: Cut broccoli florets and stems into small pieces (see cutting tip). | Heat butter, a cup of the broth, and flour in a large pot over medium-high heat. Stir briefly to mix. Add broccoli, potatoes, onion, salt, and pepper. Stir frequently for about 12 minutes. | Add 2 cups broth. Bring to a boil and reduce to simmer. Cover and cook until all vegetables are soft, at least 20 minutes, stirring once or twice. | Stir in spinach and cook until wilted, 1-2 minutes. | Transfer mixture to blender or food processor, add cheese, and blend until smooth. You can add more broth or water while blending to get the soup to the consistency that you want.

title_es: Brócoli en Horno de Microondas con Carne
ingredients_en: 3 large spoons soy sauce | 1 large spoon lemon juice | 2 small spoons cornstarch | 1 lb. round steak, cut in thin strips | 1 head broccoli, chopped | 1 onion, peeled and chopped (optional) | 1 clove garlic, peeled and minced (optional) | 1 bell pepper, cut into strips (optional)
steps_en: In a microwaveable dish, mix soy sauce, lemon juice, and cornstarch. Add steak strips and stir to coat all pieces. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes. | Drain beef and save the liquid. | Mix beef with broccoli, onion, and garlic in the microwaveable dish. Cover and microwave on high 6-8 minutes, stirring after 4 minutes, until beef is no longer pink. | Stir in bell pepper and the saved liquid. Cover and microwave 2-3 minutes on high, or until liquid is slightly thickened. | Serve with rice or noodles, cooked according to package directions.

ingredients_en: 1 head broccoli, chopped | 1 bell pepper, cut into chunks (optional) | 1 clove garlic, chopped (optional) | 6 tortillas (9 inch tortillas) | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | a pinch chili powder (optional) | 1 can (8 oz.) enchilada sauce | 1 cup cheese, shredded | 1 cup cooked meat (optional) | ½ cup black beans or other canned beans (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly oil a baking dish. | Heat oil in a frying pan, and add broccoli, bell pepper, garlic, and chili powder. | Fry the vegetables until tender, about 5-8 minutes. | Add cooked meat or beans (optional). | Put broccoli mixture on the tortillas and roll them up. | Place the tortillas in the baking dish and bake for 15 minutes. | Pour enchilada sauce, any extra broccoli mixture, and cheese over tortillas and bake for 10 more minutes.

ingredients_en: tortillas | tomato or other pasta sauce | vegetable or meat toppings | shredded cheese
steps_en: You can use any size tortilla to make this pizza. You can vary the amount of sauce, toppings, and cheese. | Heat oven to 425 degrees. Put tortilla on a baking sheet. | Spread sauce evenly across the tortilla, leaving ½ inch around edges. | Spread toppings on sauce. Sprinkle with cheese. | Bake in oven for 10-15 minutes, until cheese is bubbling and edges of the tortilla are lightly browned.

ingredients_en: 1 large spoon vegetable oil | ½ pound ground beef | ½ onion, chopped | 3 cups cabbage, chopped | 1 (16 oz.) can red kidney beans, drained | 1½ cup water | 1½ cups tomato sauce | 2 beef bouillon cubes, broken into small pieces | ½ package of Chili Seasoning (optional) | Salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: In large pot, heat oil over medium heat and add beef and onions. Cook until meat is browned. Drain excess liquid. | Add remaining ingredients to pot and stir. Make sure that the bouillon pieces are dissolved. | Cover and cook over low-med heat for 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally. If the soup is too watery, remove lid and simmer to reduce liquid to desired thickness.

title_es: Repollo/Col y Chuletas de Puerco en Horno de Microondas
ingredients_en: vegetable oil or cooking spray | 3 cups chopped cabbage | 1 apple, sliced | 4 (3 ounce) pork chops | 1 can reduced-sodium, beef broth | 2 small spoons honey (optional)
steps_en: Lightly coat 8x8-inch microwavable glass baking dish with oil or cooking spray. | Place half of the cabbage in the baking dish. Sprinkle half of the apple slices over the cabbage. Place the pork chops in the dish. Place the remaining cabbage in the dish. Top with the remaining apple slices. | Pour broth over meat and vegetables. Cover with waxed paper and microwave on high for 20-30 minutes. Turn casserole dish every 7 or 8 minutes. | Remove dish from microwave and let sit, covered, for 5 minutes. | Drizzle each serving with a few drops of honey (optional).

ingredients_en: 1 head of cabbage | 1 pound ground beef, chicken, or pork | 1 small spoon of vegetable oil | 1 can (15 oz.) mixed vegetables, drained (optional) | 1 cup cooked rice | ¼ cup onion, chopped (optional) | 1 egg, beaten | 3 garlic cloves, chopped (optional) | 1 can (10 ¾ oz.) tomato soup | salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Combine oil, onions, and garlic in a frying pan and cook on medium until tender, 3-5 minutes. Add meat and brown. Drain and transfer to a large bowl. | Add vegetables, cooked rice, egg, and 2-3 large spoons of tomato soup. Add pinches of salt and pepper or favorite seasonings. Stir thoroughly. | Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. | Cut out the entire stem of the cabbage. Carefully peel 8 leaves from the cabbage head. | Add leaves to boiling water and cook for 2-3 minutes, until tender. Cook just 3-4 leaves at a time, to avoid overcooking. Drain leaves and pat dry. Cut and discard the white center stem from each leaf. | Divide meat mixture into 8 portions. Place each leaf with stem end toward you, and place a portion of the mixture so that you can roll the leaf away from you, tucking in the sides to make a small stuffed roll. Use a toothpick to keep each roll together. | Place rolls in a casserole dish. Spread remainder of tomato soup on top. | Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes.

title_en: Cauliflower, Black Bean, Corn, and Chicken/Meat Combo
title_es: Una Combinación de Coliflor, Fríjol Negro, Elote y Pollo/Carne
ingredients_en: 1 can (15 oz.) black beans, drained | 1 can (14-15 oz.) creamed corn | 1 head of cauliflower, cut into pieces | Any cooked meat or cooked chicken, 1-2 cups | Salt and pepper, to taste (optional) | Low-fat grated cheese, chopped avocado, or low-fat sour cream (optional)
steps_en: Combine beans and corn in a large pot. Heat on low for 3-4 minutes. | In a different pot, cook the cauliflower pieces (steam, boil, or microwave). | Mix cauliflower, beans, corn, cooked meat, and seasonings. | Top with grated cheese, chopped avocado, or sour cream (optional).

ingredients_en: 2 large spoons oil | 1 pound ground meat (beef, pork, turkey) | 1 onion, peeled and cut into thin slices | 1 cup sliced vegetables such as broccoli, cauliflower, or zucchini (optional) | 1 container refrigerated pizza dough | ½ cup tomato sauce | salt and pepper or other seasoning (optional) | 1 cup shredded cheese
steps_en: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. | In large pan, heat 1 large spoon of oil and cook the onions and other vegetables until they start to get tender. Remove from pan. | Add ground meat to the pan and cook until brown. Drain liquid and season mixture with salt, pepper, or other seasonings. | Combine the meat mixture and the cooked vegetables. | Put vegetable oil or non-stick spray on a baking sheet. With your fingers, spread out pizza dough into a 15x12 inch rectangle. | Top dough with tomato sauce. Leave about 1 inch in from the edge. | Top the sauce with the meat/vegetable mixture. | Top with the cheese. Fold edges over to create a thicker crust (optional). | Bake for 15 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

title_en: Cauliflower, Corn, Rice, and Chicken/Meat Combo
title_es: Una Combinación de Coliflor, Elote, Arroz y Pollo/Carne
ingredients_en: 1 cup un-cooked rice | 1 can creamed corn (14-15 oz.) | 1 head of cauliflower, cut into pieces | any cooked meat or cooked chicken, 1-2 cups (optional) | low-fat grated cheese (optional)
steps_en: Cook rice according to instructions on the package. | Cook the cauliflower pieces (steam, boil, or microwave). | Mix together cauliflower, corn, rice, and meat. | If desired, warm mixture on stove top or in 350 degree oven for 5 minutes. | Top with grated cheese and, if desired, place in the oven on the top rack, on broil, until cheese melts. (optional)

ingredients_en: 2 small spoons vegetable oil | 2 carrots, cut into thin rounds | 1 bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch pieces (optional) | 2-3 cups green beans, ends trimmed, cut into 2-inch lengths | 3 garlic cloves, thinly sliced (optional) | 1/3 cup rice | 1 can chicken broth | 2 large spoons ketchup | 1 can (15.5 ounces) of navy beans or other canned beans, drained and rinsed | salt or favorite seasonings (optional)
steps_en: In a large, microwave-safe dish, place oil, carrots, bell pepper, green beans, and garlic. Stir to coat all the vegetables. | Cover the dish and microwave on high for 5 minutes. | Add rice, broth, ketchup, beans, 1 cup water, and a pinch of salt or other favorite seasonings. | Cover the dish and microwave on high until vegetables and rice are tender, about 5 minutes.

title_en: Microwave Chicken and Onions and Garlic
title_es: Pollo al Horno de Microondas con Cebollas y Ajo
ingredients_en: 1-2 chopped onions | 2 small spoons vegetable oil | 1 whole garlic head (optional) | 1 bell pepper, cut into squares (optional) | 1 large spoon ketchup | 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves | salt or pepper (optional) | 3 large spoons reduced-fat mayonnaise (optional) | 2 small spoons lemon juice (optional)
steps_en: In a large, microwave-safe dish, toss onions and oil. Place garlic in the center of the dish. Cover and microwave on high for 5 minutes. | Add bell pepper and ketchup to the onion mixture. Stir. | Rub chicken with salt or pepper and place on vegetables, with thickest part of breast facing edge of dish. Cover and cook on high until chicken is cooked throughout, about 15 minutes. | Remove garlic. Slice off the top and squeeze cooked cloves into a small bowl. Add mayonnaise and lemon juice and mash with a spoon. Stir this mixture into vegetables. | Serve vegetables with chicken on top.

ingredients_en: 6 baking potatoes | 1 pound ground meat (beef, turkey, or pork) | 2 large spoons chopped onion (optional) | 1 small spoon vegetable oil | ½ cup low-fat plain yogurt | 1 can green chilies (optional) | Salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings | 1cup shredded cheese (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Wash potatoes, dry them, and poke them all over with a knife. Put potatoes on a baking sheet and cook for about 1 hour, or until tender. Remove the potatoes from the oven and let them cool. | While the potatoes are cooking, put the oil in a frying pan and cook the meat and onions over medium heat until the meat is brown and the onions are soft. Drain the liquid. | Cut a thin slice off the top of each cooked potato. Scoop out the potato, leaving the potato shell. | Place the insides of the potato in a bowl. Add yogurt, chilies, salt, pepper, or any favorite seasonings. Stir well. | Stir in meat mixture and combine well. Stuff the potato shells. | Place the potatoes on a baking sheet. Sprinkle the potatoes with cheese. Bake for 10-15 minutes until heated through.

title_es: Estofado de Pollo con Hortalizas de Raíz
ingredients_en: 2 large spoons oil | 3-4 skinless boneless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch pieces | salt, pepper, or other favorite seasonings | 1/2 onion, peeled and chopped (optional) | 2 garlic cloves, peeled and chopped finely (optional) | 4-6 root vegetables (any mix of parsnips turnips rutabagas), peeled and cut into bite-size pieces | 1 sweet potato, peeled and cut into bite-size pieces | 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth | 1/4 cup raisins (optional) | 1 can (28 oz.) diced tomatoes
steps_en: Heat 1 spoon oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Sprinkle chicken pieces with salt and pepper. Add chicken to pot and cook quickly until light golden but not cooked through, 1-2 minutes. Put chicken in a bowl. | Add 1 spoon oil and onion to pot and cook until soft, 2-3 minutes. Add garlic and stir 1 minute. | Add sweet potatoes, parsnips, turnips, rutabaga, broth, and raisins (optional). | Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce to a simmer. Cook until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes. Add tomatoes and chicken with its juices to the pot. Simmer until chicken is cooked through and flavors blend, about 5 minutes longer. | Can be served over cooked rice.

ingredients_en: 1-2 potatoes | 1 large spoon vegetable oil | 1 pound ground meat (beef, turkey, or pork) | 6 taco shells | salt and pepper | low fat sour cream (optional) | salsa or chopped tomatoes (optional) | shredded lettuce or cabbage (optional) | shredded cheese (optional) | chopped cilantro (optional)
steps_en: Peel potatoes and cut into 1-inch pieces. Boil in lightly-salted water. Be sure that the water covers all of the potatoes. Cook until soft, 10-15 minutes. | Drain the potatoes and use a fork or potato mashed to smash to desired smoothness. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper. | Put vegetable oil in a frying pan. Heat the oil and cook the meat, using a wooden spoon or spatula to crumble meat into small pieces, 5-7 minutes. Drain liquid from the meat mixture. | Mix potatoes with cooked meat in a bowl. | Place generous amount of this mixture in each taco shell. Top with any of the optional ingredients.

ingredients_en: 4 parsnips | 2 large spoons vegetable oil | salt, pepper, or other favorite seasonings
steps_en: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. | Trim tops and bottoms from parsnips and peel them. Cut lengthwise into sticks about the size of french fries. | Lightly oil a baking sheet with 1 large spoon oil. | Put parsnips in a bowl with about 1 large spoon oil. Toss parsnips and oil so that parsnips are well coated. Add salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings. | Spread parsnips in a single layer on the baking sheet. | Cook for about 15-20 minutes and turn parsnips. Return to oven and cook another 10-15 minutes, until parsnips are golden brown.

title_es: Pan de Zanahoria (Usando un Horno de Microondas Parcialmente)
ingredients_en: 3 cups grated carrots | 1½ cups all-purpose flour | 2 small spoons baking powder | 1/4 small spoon baking soda | 3/4 small spoon salt | 4 eggs, beaten | 1 cup packed brown sugar | 1 stick unsalted butter or margarine, melted, and cooled
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | In a medium microwave-safe bowl, combine carrots with 3 large spoons of water. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave until tender, 4 minutes. Drain carrots. | In a large bowl, stir together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Stir in eggs, sugar, and butter until combined. Mix in carrots. | Coat a loaf pan (9” x 5”) with butter or margarine or non-stick spray. Or, place wax paper to line the pan. Put mixture into this dish. | Bake until the top is golden brown and a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean, about 35 minutes. Let cool slightly before serving.

ingredients_en: 2 cups zucchini, grated | ¼ cup onion, finely chopped (optional) | 2 eggs, beaten | ¼ cup flour | ½ cup bread crumbs | pinch of salt or pepper or other favorite seasonings | 2 large spoons vegetable oil or cooking spray
steps_en: In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients, except the oil. Mix well. | Spray frying pan with cooking spray or heat vegetable oil in the pan, at medium heat. | Drop large spoonfuls of zucchini mixture into the pan. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden brown. | Drain on a baking rack or paper towel. Serve immediately.

ingredients_en: 1 cup rice | 1-2 pounds of ground meat (beef, turkey, or pork) | 1 onion, peeled and chopped into chunks | 2-4 carrots, peeled and cut into 3-inch sticks | 4 large spoons of oil | ½ cup of raisins | pinch of salt and pepper
steps_en: Heat oven to 325 degrees. | Heat 2 large spoons of oil in a pan, add onions, stir and cook until brown, about 5 minutes. Remove onions. | Add ground meat to the pan. Use a wooden spoon or spatula to break meat apart, and cook until brown. Add 1 cup of water, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil. Lower the heat, cover and simmer until the meat is cooked through, another 5 minutes. Remove meat from this broth. | Add cooked onions to the broth. | Heat 2 large spoons of oil in a different pan and add the carrot pieces. Cook gently, stirring until they are lightly browned and tender, adding a little water if needed to keep the carrots wet. Add raisins and cook gently until they get larger, 2-3 minutes more. | Bring 4-5 cups of water to a boil in another pot, add 1 small spoon of salt, and add rice. When water returns to a boil, cook rice for 2-3 minutes, and drain. | Mix rice and the onions with broth. Spread this mixture in a large casserole dish. Place cooked meat on top of rice, on one side of the dish, and the mixture of carrots and raisins on the other side. Bake in oven for 25 minutes. | To serve, you may want to separate carrot mixture, meat, and rice. Or, you may want to mix them together.

ingredients_en: 2 large brown potatoes | 3-4 carrots | 2 cloves garlic, peeled (optional) | ¼ cup low-fat milk (optional) | 2 large spoons butter or margarine | Salt, pepper, or other seasonings (optional)
steps_en: Peel potatoes and cut into 1 inch pieces | Peel carrots and cut into ½ inch pieces | Combine potatoes, carrots, and garlic in a pot. Cover with water. Add a pinch of salt (optional). Bring to a boil and simmer until completely tender, about 20 minutes. | Drain vegetables, saving the cooking water. | Add milk and butter to the vegetables. | Use potato masher or fork to mash until smooth. Add cooking water to get desired texture. | Season with salt, pepper, or other seasonings (optional).

ingredients_en: ½ cup cooked sweet potato (boil, bake, or microwave) | 1 small container low-fat plain or vanilla yogurt | ½ cup orange juice, or to taste | 1small spoon vanilla extract (optional)
steps_en: Peel the cooked sweet potato. Mash the sweet potato with a potato masher or fork. | Combine the sweet potato with the other ingredients in a blender. | Blend until smooth. Adjust ingredients to taste.

title_es: Pastinacas/Chirivías y Manzanas Horneadas con Miel
ingredients_en: 2-3 parsnips, peeled and cut into sticks, the size of French fries | 1 sweet potato, peeled and cut into sticks, the size of French fries (optional) | 2 apples, peeled and cored and cut into sticks, the size of French fries | 2 large spoons oil | 1 large spoon honey | 1 large spoon vinegar
steps_en: Heat oven to 375 degrees. | With 1 spoon oil, grease inside of a casserole dish. | In a small pan over low heat, combine 1 spoon oil, honey, and vinegar. Stir until mixed. | Combine vegetable and apple pieces in a bowl. Toss with the honey mixture until all pieces are coated. | Put combination in casserole dish, cover with aluminum foil, and bake until tender, 45-60 minutes.

title_en: Maple Glazed Chicken and Root Vegetables
title_es: Pollo Glaseado con Miel de Maple (Arce) y Hortalizas Tipo Raíz
ingredients_en: 1 whole chicken cut into parts (breasts, wings, thighs, drumsticks), about 3 pounds | 1 large spoon oil | 2 cups root vegetables (rutabaga, turnips, or parsnips), peeled and cut into pieces (slices, sticks, or chunks) | 1 cup peeled potatoes, cut into pieces | 1 cup peeled carrots, cut into pieces (optional) | 1 cup chicken broth | 1 large spoon butter or margarine | 1/3 cup maple syrup | salt and pepper
steps_en: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Grease a baking dish with oil. | Place chicken pieces in the baking dish. Arrange vegetables around chicken pieces, season with salt and pepper. Pour broth over chicken and vegetables. Bake for 20 minutes. | In the meantime, in a pan, melt butter and stir in maple syrup. Brush mixture over chicken and vegetables and bake for another 15-20 minutes, until chicken is cooked all the way through. Brush chicken frequently with maple-butter mix. | Remove chicken and vegetables from pan. With a spoon, skim fat from liquid. Pour remainder of liquid over chicken.

ingredients_en: 1 onion, peeled and sliced thinly | 1 bell pepper (red, green, or yellow), sliced thinly | 3 cups of cooked meat (chicken or turkey pieces, or slices of beef or pork) | 1 15 oz. can of corn or creamed corn | 8 tortillas, 6-inch, warmed in a frying pan over medium heat (half a minute per side for each) | 1 cup picante sauce or salsa | 1 cup of pitted ripe olives, sliced | 2 large spoons vegetable oil
steps_en: Heat oil in a pan, cook onion and pepper slices until they are tender, stirring occasionally, 5-7 minutes. | Reduce heat to low and add the corn and meat. Cook until the mixture is hot and bubbling. | Spoon about a 1/3 cup of meat mixture in the center of each tortilla. Fold tortillas around the filling. | Serve with bowl of the remaining meat mixture, and bowls of sauce or sliced olives, so diners can top their fajitas or add to the filling, as they wish.

title_en: Chicken, Stuffing, and Green Bean Casserole
title_es: Guiso de Pollo, Relleno y Ejotes
ingredients_en: 1 (6 oz.) package seasoned stuffing mix, prepared according to package directions | 2-3 chicken breasts, cooked and cut into small pieces | 1 can (10.5 oz.) condensed cream of chicken soup | 2-4 cups green beans, tips trimmed and cut into ½ inch pieces | 1 cup canned or frozen corn | ½ onion, peeled and chopped finely (optional) | 2 cloves garlic, peeled and chopped (optional) | 1 cup Cheddar or other cheese, shredded | Salt and pepper, to taste (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Boil green beans in a pot of water until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain | In a bowl, mix together cooked chicken, condensed soup, green beans, corn, onions, garlic, and salt and pepper. | In a baking dish (9x13 inches) spread out the chicken and vegetable mixture. Top with prepared stuffing. Sprinkle with cheese. | Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes. Remove cover and bake for another 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and browned.

ingredients_en: 1 head of cauliflower | 1 medium onion, peeled and chopped | juice of 1 lemon (optional) | 2 large spoons vegetable oil | 2 chicken breasts, cooked and cut into small pieces | ¼ cup low-fat sour cream | 1 cup low-fat cheddar cheese | salt and pepper (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | Remove and discard green leaves from bottom of cauliflower. Cut cauliflower in half from top to bottom. Cut away the tough stem from both halves. Chop remaining cauliflower into bite-size pieces. | Combine cauliflower pieces, onion, lemon juice, and oil. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper. | Coat a baking dish with oil or line with aluminum foil. | Spread mixture onto baking dish. | Bake for 20 minutes. Stir and bake for another 20 minutes. (40 minutes total.) | Stir in the chicken and sour cream. Sprinkle top with cheese. Bake for another 5 minutes or until cheese has melted.

ingredients_en: 8 or more chicken thighs or 6 chicken breasts (may be skinless and/or boneless) | ½ cup of flour | pinch of salt and pepper | 2 large spoons of oil | 2 cups of chicken broth | 2 cups of cauliflower florets | 2 cups of any other vegetables (carrots, peeled and cut into small pieces; onions, peeled and chopped into small pieces; green beans, cut into one-inch lengths)
steps_en:
Wash chicken and pat dry. Cut into bite size pieces. | Cut large cauliflower florets in half. | Place flour, salt, and pepper in a plastic bag. Add chicken pieces and shake to coat. | Add oil to a large frying pan or skillet over medium heat. Brown chicken pieces 
on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Drain liquid. | Add broth, bring to a boil, reduce to simmer, and cover. Cook about 30 minutes. | Add vegetables, cover, and cook until vegetables are tender, about another 10 minutes.

ingredients_en: 6-7 cups beef for stew, cut into 1 ½ inch cubes | ⅓ cup tomato paste | 3 large spoons vinegar | 2 large spoons flour | salt and pepper | 2 onions, cut into chunks | 4 cups potatoes, peeled and cut into one-inch chunks | 3-4 cups carrots, peeled and cut into small chunks | 3-6 cloves garlic, peeled and smashed (optional) | 3 cups of water
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | In a large pot with a tight-fitting lid, combine tomato paste, vinegar, flour, pinches of salt and pepper, and one cup of water. Mix well. | Add beef, onions, potatoes, carrots, garlic, and 2 cups of water. Stir and bring to a boil. | Cover pot and put in oven. Cook until meat is tender, about 2-2 ½ hours.

ingredients_en: 6-7 cups beef for stew, cut into 1 ½ inch cubes | ⅓ cup tomato paste | 3 large spoons vinegar | 2 large spoons flour | salt and pepper | 2 onions, cut into chunks | 4 cups potatoes, peeled and cut into one-inch chunks | 3-4 cups carrots, peeled and cut into small chunks | 3-6 cloves garlic, peeled and smashed (optional) | 3 cups of water
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | In a large pot with a tight-fitting lid, combine tomato paste, vinegar, flour, pinches of salt and pepper, and one cup of water. Mix well. | Add beef, onions, potatoes, carrots, garlic, and 2 cups of water. Stir and bring to a boil. | Cover pot and put in oven. Cook until meat is tender, about 2-2½ hours.

ingredients_en: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts | 2 zucchini | salt and pepper or other favorite seasonings | garlic salt (optional) | onion powder (optional) | 2 lemon slices (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. | Cut 2 sheets of aluminum foil, about 12 inches long. Coat the foil with a small amount of vegetable oil. | Slice zucchini into 1/4 inch pieces. Divide the zucchini onto the two sheets of foil. | Place chicken breasts on top of zucchini. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, garlic salt, onion powder, or other favorite seasonings. Place a lemon slice on top of each chicken. | Cut two more sheets of foil. Put a sheet on top of each of the chicken breasts. Fold the edge together tightly to make two packets. | Place foil packets on baking sheet and cook for 30 minutes.

ingredients_en: 1 pound ground meat (beef, turkey, or pork) | 1 onion, peeled and chopped | 2 cloves of garlic, peeled and chopped (optional) | 1 head of cauliflower | 2-3 carrots, peeled and cut into ½-inch chunks (optional) | 2 cans (10.7 oz.) cream of mushroom soup | 1 cup water | pinch of salt and pepper, or any favorite seasonings | vegetable oil | 1 package seasoned stuffing mix (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Use 1-2 large spoons of oil to lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish. | Remove and discard green leaves from bottom of cauliflower. Cut cauliflower in half from top to bottom. Cut away the tough stem from both halves. Chop remaining cauliflower into bite-size pieces. | Heat 1 large spoon of oil in a pan on medium heat. Cook onions and garlic, mixed with a pinch of salt and pepper or any favorite seasonings, until soft, 4-5 minutes. Remove onion mixture from pan. | Add meat to pan. Crumble meat into separate pieces and brown for 7-10 minutes, stirring repeatedly. | Drain liquid from meat. Add onion mixture to the meat in the pan. Mix well | Transfer meat and onion mixture to the baking dish. Mix cauliflower pieces and carrot pieces in a bowl, and spread on top. | Mix soup with 1 cup water and spread evenly over the top of the vegetables. | Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until vegetables are tender. | Optional: If you want to top the dish with cheese, or bread crumbs, or crushed cornflakes, sprinkle your topping on the dish after 20 minutes of baking. | Optional: Mix a small bag of packaged, seasoned stuffing with the cauliflower and carrots before adding them to the dish.

ingredients_en: 1large spoon vegetable oil | 1 onion, peeled and chopped into small pieces | 2 cloves garlic, peeled and chopped (optional) | 1 pound ground beef | 3-4 cups fresh green beans, tips trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 can (14.5 oz.) diced tomatoes | salt and pepper | spaghetti noodles or any other noodles (optional)
steps_en: Put oil in a pan and cook onions at medium heat until soft, about 3-5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add beef, breaking it into little pieces, and cook until brown. | Remove mixture from pan and put into a bowl. Leave liquid in the pan. | Add green beans to the pan and cook for 4-5 minutes. Add the tomatoes to the pan and cook until warmed through. Add the beef mixture to the pan and cook for another 10 minutes. You can add a bit of water, if needed. | Season with a pinch of salt and pepper. | Serve with spaghetti noodles (or any other noodles), prepared according to package (optional).

title_en: Pan-roasted Chicken with Lemon-Garlic Green Beans
title_es: Pollo Asado al Sartén con Ejotes y Limón al Mojo de Ajo
ingredients_en: 4 chicken breasts, with bones and skin | 2-3 large potatoes, cut into wedges | 2-3 large hands-full of green beans, ends trimmed | 4 garlic cloves, peeled and chopped finely (optional) | 2 lemons, 1 thinly sliced and 1 juiced | vegetable oil | pinch of salt and pepper
steps_en: Heat oven to 375 degrees. | Coat a large baking dish with one large spoon of oil, or line the dish with aluminum foil. Place lemon slices in a single layer that covers the bottom. | In a large bowl, combine 4 large spoons of oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper. Add green beans, toss to coat, remove with slotted spoon, and place on lemon slices in baking dish. | Add potato wedges to same oil mixture, toss to coat, remove with slotted spoon, and place around the edges of baking dish. | Place chicken pieces in same mixture, coat thoroughly, and place skin-side up in the baking dish center. | Cover dish tightly with aluminum foil. | Cook for 25 minutes. Remove foil and cook for another 20 minutes. Remove chicken and cook for another 10 minutes, if needed, until potatoes are tender.

ingredients_en: 2 onions | vegetable oil | pinch of salt and pepper, or other favorite seasonings
steps_en: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. | Lightly grease a baking sheet with 1 large spoon of oil. | Peel onions and cut into quarters. | In a bowl, stir 1 large spoon oil, salt, pepper, or other seasonings. Add onions and coat completely. | Place onions on a baking sheet and cook for about 30 minutes. Onions should be cooked through and soft. | These onions can be used as a side dish or added to soups, stews, eggs, or other dishes.

ingredients_en: 2 large spoons vegetable oil | 4 onions, peeled and thinly sliced | 4 cups chicken or beef broth | 2-3 cups water | 2 carrots, peeled and thinly sliced (optional) | 2 stalks of celery, thinly sliced (optional) | 1 cup uncooked noodles (any shape) | 2 cups cooked chicken, cut into small pieces | salt and pepper
steps_en: Put oil in a large pot and heat over medium heat. Add onions and cook 5-7 minutes until golden brown, stirring occasionally.
