Remove onions from pot and put in a bowl. | Into the pot, add broth, water, carrots, and celery, and bring to a boil. Stir in noodles. Cook for about 12-15 minutes or until noodles are cooked. | Reduce heat and add the chicken and onions to the pot to warm. | Season with a pinch of salt and pepper.

ingredients_en: 4 cups water | 1-2 cups cooked ham, cut into small chunks (optional) | 2 cups potatoes, peeled and cut into small pieces | 1 onion, peeled and sliced | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 (10.7 oz.) can condensed cream of potato or condensed cream of chicken soup | 1½ cups low-fat milk | 3 cups fresh green beans, ends trimmed and cut into ½ inch pieces | 1 cup canned or frozen corn | salt and pepper
steps_en: In a pot, add the water, ham, potatoes, onions, and bouillon cube. Bring to a boil then reduce heat to medium low. Cook until potatoes are tender, about 35 minutes. | Add condensed soup, milk, green beans, and corn to pot. | Cook for another 10-15 minutes. Skim off any excess fat. | Season with salt or pepper, to taste.

ingredients_en: 6 potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 2-3 onions, peeled and thinly sliced | 1 can (10.7 oz.) cream of mushroom soup | ½ cup low-fat milk | Grated cheddar cheese (optional) | Salt and pepper (optional) | Vegetable oil
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. | In a small bowl, mix the mushroom soup and the milk. Add a pinch of salt and pepper, if desired. | Grease a baking dish with 1 large spoon oil. Put in a layer of potatoes, then a layer of onions, topped with cheese. Drizzle some of the soup mixture on top. Continue to create layers of potatoes, onions, cheese, and soup mixture. | Top with cheese. Bake for an hour or more, until potatoes are tender.

ingredients_en: 3 cups of chicken parts, cut into 1½ inch pieces | salt, pepper, or other favorite seasonings | 1 clove garlic, peeled and finely chopped (optional) | 1 onion, peeled and chopped (optional) | 3 cups cauliflower florets, large florets cut into smaller sections | 1 cup frozen peas
steps_en:
You may want to prepare this recipe in two or more batches. That depends on the size of your microwave dish. Divide chicken pieces into as many batches as you will need.
Divide cauliflower and peas into as many batches as you will need. | Arrange some of the chicken pieces on a microwavable baking dish, in a single layer with skin sides up. | Sprinkle with a pinch of salt, pepper, favorite seasonings, and garlic. Add some chopped onion. | Cover tightly and microwave on high for 5 minutes. Stir. Cook another 5 minutes. | Add some cauliflower and peas. Rotate baking dish 1/2 turn. | Cover tightly, again, and microwave on high until thickest parts of chicken are done and vegetables are tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Transfer to a dish you can keep warm. | Repeat with second or more batches.

title_es: Papas Crujientes al Horno Estilo Papas a la Francesa
ingredients_en: 2 large brown potatoes | salt, pepper, or other favorite seasonings | vegetable oil
steps_en: Heat oven to 475 degrees, and adjust oven rack to lowest position. | Lightly coat a baking sheet with 1 large spoon of oil. | Peel potatoes. Cut potatoes into sticks, the width of a pencil and the full length of the potatoes. Uniform size helps the oven fries cook evenly. | Soak potato sticks in a bowl of cold water in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. | Discard water, rinse, and drain the potatoes. Pat dry thoroughly with paper towels. | Toss potatoes with 2 large spoons of vegetable oil and pinches of salt, pepper, or other seasonings. | Place the potatoes in a single layer on the baking sheet. | Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake for 5 minutes. Remove foil and bake for another 15 minutes, or until potatoes start to brown. | Turn sticks over and bake for another 15 minutes, or until potatoes reach desired color and crispness.

title_es: Calabacitas Parmesanas en Horno de Microondas
ingredients_en: 2 zucchini | salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings | ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 can (4 oz.) mushrooms, drained (optional) | ½ cup shredded white cheese (such as mozzarella) | 1 jar (8 oz.) tomato sauce
steps_en: Slice zucchini thinly and evenly. Layer in a 12 x 7 inch glass baking dish. Cook on high for 5 minutes. | Remove from microwave, sprinkle with pinches of salt, pepper, or favorite seasonings. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. | Top with mushrooms, white cheese, and then tomato sauce. | Cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes until hot and bubbly.

title_es: Estofado de Carne y Hortalizas de Raíz
ingredients_en: ¼ cup of flour, plus 2 large spoons for thickening, if desired | 1 small spoon of salt | 1 small spoon of pepper | 1 pound of beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 3 large spoons of vegetable oil | 1 can (16 oz.) of stewed tomatoes, including juice | 1 onion, peeled and sliced (optional) | 1 ½ cup of water | ½ cup of maple syrup | 3 cups root vegetables (any combination of turnips, rutabagas, parsnips), peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 carrots, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces (optional)
steps_en: Combine ¼ cup flour with salt and pepper in a plastic bag. Pat meat dry with paper towels. Add beef pieces to bag and shake to coat. | Heat oil in a large pot. Brown meat on all sides. | Add tomatoes, onions, water, and maple syrup. Bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat to a simmer and cook for an hour, or until meat is tender. | Stir in pieces of rutabagas, turnips, parsnips, and carrots. Continue cooking for 45 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Stir occasionally. Add water when cooking, if mixture becomes dry. | If desired, to thicken stew, stir 2 large spoons of flour with ¼ cup water. Mix thoroughly with stew.

ingredients_en: 1 sweet potato | salt or your favorite seasonings, to taste | vegetable oil
steps_en: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Lightly coat a baking sheet with vegetable oil. | Peel sweet potato and cut into slices as thin as possible. Cut rounds into half moons, if you wish. | In a bowl, mix sweet potato slices with 1 small spoon of vegetable oil. Make sure the sweet potatoes are coated all over. | Spread sweet potatoes in a single layer on the baking sheet. Make sure the potatoes are not overlapping. | Sprinkle salt or seasonings on sweet potatoes. | Bake for 5 minutes. Turn sweet potatoes and sprinkle with a bit more salt or seasonings, if desired. Continue cooking potatoes and turning them every 5 minutes until they are cooked through and crisp, about 20 minutes total.

ingredients_en: 3 cups root vegetables (any combination of turnips, rutabagas, parsnips), peeled and sliced about ¼ inch thick | 1 cup carrots, peeled and sliced about ¼ inch thick | salt and pepper or other favorite seasonings | 3/4 cup grated cheese | 1 cup low-fat milk | Vegetable oil or cooking spray
steps_en: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees | Lightly coat a baking dish (9x13 inches) with vegetable oil or cooking spray. | Place the sliced vegetables in a large bowl, and toss with 1 large spoon oil and pinches of salt, pepper, or other favorite seasonings. | Place a layer of vegetables in the baking dish and top with some of the milk. Add layers of vegetables and milk until all ingredients are used. | Cover dish tightly with aluminum foil. | Bake 45 minutes. During baking, every 15 minutes, use the back of a spoon to press the vegetables into the milk. | Uncover the dish and add the cheese. Return to the oven and bake another 30 to 45 minutes, until vegetables and cheese are browned and most of the liquid is absorbed.

title_es: Pollo a la Naranja con Calabacitas
ingredients_en: 2 chicken breasts, boneless and skinless | 3 large spoons vegetable oil | zest of one orange | ½ cup orange juice | 2 small spoons ginger root, finely chopped (optional) | 1 small spoon salt | ½ cup chicken broth | 2-3 zucchini | 2 cloves garlic, peeled and chopped (optional)
steps_en: Wash, clean, and dry chicken breasts. Cut into 1-inch pieces and place in a glass or ceramic bowl. Add 2 large spoons of oil, orange zest, orange juice, chopped ginger, and salt. | Mix ingredients and let sit for 30 minutes at room temperature. Then, remove chicken pieces and put on a plate. | Cut zucchini into ½ inch pieces. | Heat 1 large spoon vegetable oil in a large frying pan on medium-high heat. Add chicken pieces and cook until brown, about 5-7 minutes. Stir and make sure you allow space around each piece of chicken to allow proper browning. You may need to cook chicken in two batches. Remove cooked chicken and place in a bowl. | Add chicken broth to pan and scrape any bits of chicken or other flavorings from the bottom of the pan. Add zucchini and garlic and cook, on medium heat, until tender, 2-3 minutes, stirring often. Return chicken pieces and juices to the pan, and cook for another 1-2 minutes.

ingredients_en: 1 pound ground meat (turkey, beef, or pork) | 1 onion, peeled and cut into half-inch pieces | 2 apples, cut into half-inch pieces | 2 sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into half-inch pieces | 2 large spoons of butter | vegetable oil | salt and pepper | small bag of spinach, chopped (optional) | 4 eggs (optional) | small dish of low-fat yoghurt (optional) | 2-3 chopped green onions (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. | Heat a frying pan and add the meat. Crumble the meat into small pieces and cook 5-7 minutes, on medium. | Use vegetable oil or non-stick spray to coat the inside of a baking dish (9x13 inches). | Combine onions, apples, and sweet potatoes in a bowl with melted butter and a large spoon of oil. Toss with pinches of salt and pepper to taste. | Spread vegetable mixture in baking dish. Cook for 30-35 minutes, stirring twice. | Add meat to baking dish and stir with vegetable mixture. If you wish, also mix in the chopped spinach. Return to oven for 5-7 minutes. | If you wish, form the hash into four patties for serving, and top each with a fried egg. Or, serve hash loosely on each plate, and offer yoghurt or chopped green onions as a topping.

ingredients_en: 1½ lbs. pork loin, cut into 1 inch cubes | salt and pepper | 2 large spoons of flour | 2 large spoons, vegetable oil | ½ large onion, chopped | 2 stalks celery, chopped (optional) | 2 cloves garlic, finely chopped (optional) | 1 cup chicken broth | ½ cup apple, cranberry, or apple-cranberry juice | 1 cup water | 3-4 sweet potatoes, peeled, cut into 1inch cubes
steps_en: Sprinkle pork cubes with salt and pepper. | In a bowl, place flour. Add pork and toss to coat. | In large pot over medium heat, add 1 large spoon of oil. Add pork and brown on all sides. Remove pork from the pan and place in a bowl. | In same pot that the pork was in, add 1 large spoon of oil. Add onion and celery and cook for about 5-7 minutes, or until tender. | Add garlic and any remaining flour and stir. | Add broth, juice, and water. Return pork to pot. Add sweet potatoes. Stir to mix thoroughly, scraping bottom of pot. | Bring to boil then reduce heat to a simmer and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until pork and potatoes are tender. Season to taste with salt or pepper (optional). | If you want sauce to be thicker, mix in 1-2 large spoons of flour.

ingredients_en: 5 strips of bacon (optional) | 1 small or medium head cabbage | 3 large brown potatoes | ½ cup broth | pinch of salt or pepper | ½ cup shredded Swiss cheese or other cheese
steps_en: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. | Remove outer leaves of cabbage. Set the cabbage on its end and cut in half. Remove the core and chop the remaining cabbage into strips. | Peel and chop potatoes into bite-size pieces. | Separate strips of bacon, cut into 1-inch pieces, and cook in an oven-proof pot. Stir occasionally, until bacon begins to crisp, 5-7 minutes. | Add cabbage strips to the pot and cook, covered. Stir occasionally, until cabbage is soft, about 10 minutes. | Add potato pieces, broth, salt and pepper. Mix ingredients thoroughly. | Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and bake for 15 minutes. | Uncover and continue baking until potatoes are tender and mixture is bubbling, about 15-20 more minutes.

ingredients_en: 1-2 carrots, chopped into small pieces | ½ cup canned, crushed pineapple | 4 large spoons orange juice | ½ cup ice | ½ banana, sliced (optional)
steps_en: Place all of the ingredients in a blender. | Blend until smooth. Adjust ingredients to taste.

ingredients_en: 1-2 cups broccoli florets, chopped into small pieces | 1 cup frozen blueberries | 1 cup low-fat milk | ½ banana | handful of raisins (optional)
steps_en: Place all of the ingredients in a blender. | Blend until smooth. Adjust ingredients to taste.

ingredients_en: ½ cup cauliflower florets | ½ cup frozen raspberries or frozen mixed berries | ½ banana | ½ cup low-fat milk | 1 small spoon vanilla extract | 2 large spoons low-fat plain or flavored yogurt
steps_en: Place all of the ingredients in a blender. | Blend until smooth. Adjust ingredients to taste.

ingredients_en: 2 cups chopped cabbage | ½ cup water | 1 banana | 1 cup frozen strawberries | 1 container low-fat strawberry yogurt
steps_en: Place all of the ingredients in a blender. | Blend until smooth. Adjust ingredients to taste.

ingredients_en: 1 handful of green beans, chopped | 2 handfuls of spinach (optional) | 1 apple, peeled, cored, and chopped into small pieces | 1 banana | ½ cup water | ice
steps_en: Place all of the ingredients in a blender. | Blend until smooth. Adjust ingredients to taste.

ingredients_en: 1 zucchini, chopped into small pieces | 1 banana, cut into small pieces | 1 apple, peeled, cored, and chopped into small pieces | ½ cup water
steps_en: Place all of the ingredients in a blender. | Blend until smooth. Add additional water, if needed.

ingredients_en: 2 parsnips | 1 apple, peeled, cored and cut into small pieces | 1 cup apple juice | 1 large spoon honey (optional)
steps_en: Peel the parsnips and cut into small pieces. Put ½ cup of water in a pan. Add the parsnips and cook, covered, until the parsnips are soft, about 5-7 minutes. | Drain and cool the parsnips. You can store the cooked parsnips in the refrigerator until you are ready to use them. | Place all of the ingredients in a blender. Blend until smooth.

ingredients_en: tortillas | tomato or other pasta sauce | vegetable or meat toppings | shredded cheese
steps_en: You can use any size tortilla to make this pizza. You can vary the amount of sauce, toppings, and cheese. | Heat oven to 425 degrees. Put tortilla on a baking sheet. | Spread sauce evenly across the tortilla, leaving ½ inch around edges. | Spread toppings on sauce. Sprinkle with cheese. | Bake in oven for 10-15 minutes, until cheese is bubbling and edges of the tortilla are lightly browned.

ingredients_en: tortillas | tomato or other pasta sauce | vegetable or meat toppings | shredded cheese
steps_en: You can use any size tortilla to make this pizza. You can vary the amount of sauce, toppings, and cheese. | Heat oven to 425 degrees. Put tortilla on a baking sheet. | Spread sauce evenly across the tortilla, leaving ½ inch around edges. | Spread toppings on sauce. Sprinkle with cheese | Bake in oven for 10-15 minutes, until cheese is bubbling and edges of the tortilla are lightly browned.

ingredients_en: tortillas | tomato or other pasta sauce | vegetable or meat toppings | shredded cheese
steps_en: You can use any size tortilla to make this pizza. You can vary the amount of sauce, toppings, and cheese. | Heat oven to 425 degrees. Put tortilla on a baking sheet. | Spread sauce evenly across the tortilla, leaving ½ inch around edges. | Spread toppings on sauce. Sprinkle with cheese. | Bake in oven for 10-15 minutes, until cheese is bubbling and edges of the tortilla are lightly browned.

title_es: Sopa de Coliflor Asada y Manzana
ingredients_en: 1 cauliflower | 2 apples, peeled and cut into small pieces | 1 onion, peeled and cut into small pieces | 3 peeled cloves garlic (optional) | ¼ cup sliced ginger (optional) | 3 large spoons vegetable oil | 5 cups chicken or vegetable broth | pinch of salt (optional)
steps_en: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. | Cut out the tough stem of the cauliflower. Then, cut the cauliflower into small pieces. | Put the cauliflower, apples, onions, ginger, garlic, and salt in a roasting pan or baking sheet. Add the oil and toss to coat everything. | Bake for 40 minutes. Mix once or twice. Cook until cauliflower is lightly browned and the onion is tender. | Work in a few batches. Put the vegetables in a blender or food processor with some of the broth. Don’t fill the blender or food processor more than half full. Mix until very smooth. After the soup is blended, put it in a large pot. | Reheat the soup over low temperature.

ingredients_en: 2 large baking potatoes | 1 cup cooked broccoli (steamed, boiled, or Microwaved), chopped into small pieces | 2 large spoons of butter or margarine | 1 green onion, including green part, finely chopped (optional) | ½ cup low-fat sour cream (optional) | 1 cup shredded cheese, any kind (optional) | salt and pepper, to taste
steps_en: To bake the potatoes, first clean them and stab them several times with a fork or sharp knife. This will allow heat to be released as the potatoes bake. | Bake the potatoes for 50-60 minutes at 350 degrees. | Slice the potato in half, lengthwise. Scoop out the insides and mash in a bowl with the butter or margarine, until smooth. | Add the green onion, sour cream, or shredded cheese (optional). | Mix in pinch of salt and pepper. | Stir in the broccoli pieces. | Stuff the potato-broccoli filling into the potato skins. Put any extra filling in an oven proof container. | Cook the stuffed potatoes (and any extra filling) for 1015 minutes at 350 degrees.

title_en: Crock Pot Chicken and Carrot Stew
title_es: Estofado de Pollo y Zanahorias en una Olla Eléctrica Tipo "Crock Pot"
ingredients_en: 3 large potatoes or 6 small potatoes, peeled and cut into medium-size chunks | 3-4 carrots, peeled and cut into medium-size chunks | 4 chicken half-breasts, either boneless or with the bone | 1 can (10 ¾ ounce) condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can (10 ¾ ounce) condensed cream of mushroom soup | pinch of salt, pepper, garlic salt, garlic powder, or other favorite seasonings (optional) | frozen peas or other frozen vegetables (optional)
steps_en: Trim and throw away the excess fat from the chicken. The chicken can be cooked with or without the skin. | Place all ingredients in the crock pot and mix completely. Sprinkle with favorite seasonings (optional). | Cook on low for 6 hours. Check in 5 ½ hours to see if chicken is cooked and vegetables are tender. | If you are adding frozen peas (or other frozen vegetables), toss them into the crock pot and continue cooking for 15-20 minutes.

title_en: Onion Pot Roast in a Crock Pot
title_es: Guisado de Carne con Cebollas en una Olla Eléctrica Tipo "Crock Pot"
ingredients_en: 2½ pounds boneless chuck roast | 4 medium onions, peeled and sliced | 3 large spoons vegetable oil | pinches of salt and pepper | 1 cup beef broth | ½ cup apple juice | 1 large spoon brown sugar | 1 large spoon vinegar | 2 large spoons mustard
steps_en: Pat meat dry all over. Lightly salt and pepper all over. | Heat oil in a pot or large pan at medium high, and brown the meat on all sides. Remove to a plate. | Add onions to the pot or pan and cook until brown, stirring often. | Combine broth, juice, sugar, vinegar, and mustard in a bowl. Add to the onions when browned. | Put half the onion mixture in crock pot, and place the meat on top. Cover with rest of onion mixture. | Cook on low 6 to 7 hours.

title_en: Crock Pot Pork and Sweet Potatoes
title_es: Puerco en Olla "Crock Pot" y Camotes
ingredients_en: 1½ pounds boneless pork, cut into 1 inch chunks | 6 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch chunks | 1-2 large onions, peeled and cut into chunks | 1 cup barbeque sauce (any flavor) | 2 garlic cloves, minced (optional)
steps_en: Place pork in the bottom of the crock pot. | In a large bowl, combine sweet potatoes, onions, barbeque sauce, and garlic. Mix well and add to crock pot. | Cook on low for 5-5 ½ hours, or until meat is cooked and vegetables are tender.
